eden.uk.plus1.title: Wild West: America's Great Frontier - The High Country

A team of scientists is recruited by a mysterious corporation to search for a power source in the "Hollow Earth", using Kong as their guide. But Godzilla sees Kong as a rival to his dominance of the surface world, and there can only be one alpha.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Casino Royale
itv1anglia.uk.description: James Bond spoof, starring David Niven, Peter Sellers and Ursula Andress. Agent 007, whose exploits on behalf of his country have resulted in a knighthood, is now enjoying his retirement to the full. But when "M" is killed, Bond is called back into active service to halt the threat of the cash-strapped SMERSH organisation.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 Yorkshire Dales (30min) James explores the culinary delights of his native Yorkshire, where he is joined by good friend and fellow chef Brian Turner. James cooks tea-smoked trout on the Coniston Estate and later brushes up his clay-pigeon shooting skills, while Brian is challenged to a spot of off-road driving.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E14 Avery Island James heads to Louisiana and Avery Island, a large salt mound that is the home of the chilli peppers used to make Tabasco sauce. He meets the family who farm the peppers, make the sauce and run the Tabasco company and is even granted access to the pepper fields to cook two amazing dishes.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itv1anglia.uk.description: S8 E26 Alan is joined by Mark Benton, Elizabeth Carling and Bill Fellows, while florist Simon Lycett creates a new centrepiece for the barn using seasonal blooms.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News
itv1anglia.uk.description: E81 24/10/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E32 James cooks lamb and turbot for actor Richard Armitage, currently starring in ITV1 crime drama Winter. Plus, recipes from chefs Atul Kochhar, John Hooker and Mark Birchall.

itvgranada.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands - Yorkshire Dales
itvgranada.uk.description: James returns home to his native Yorkshire, where he is joined by good friend and multi award-winning chef Brian Turner. James visits top chef Frances Atkins' beautiful restaurant the Yorke Arms, where he enjoys her signature dish al fresco, in her unusual dining room the Onion. Brian tastes the delights of some Yorkshire charcuterie, and later they both take time out, where James brushes up his clay pigeon skills and Brian is challenged to some off-road driving. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2020

itvgranada.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure - Avery Island
itvgranada.uk.description: James continues with a trip to an island that's not actually an island. Avery Island is a large salt mound and the home of the chili peppers that are used to make Tabasco sauce. James meets the family who farm the peppers, make the sauce and run the Tabasco company, and he's even granted access to the pepper fields to cook two amazing dishes. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2018

talkingpictures.uk.description: Micheal Aspel explores a family who claim they have all been terrorised by the same poltergeist and try to rid them of the spirit so they can live in peace. (Biography, Mystery) - 1997

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Brothers - Hit and Miss
talkingpictures.uk.description: Hit and Miss. 1974. Stars Richard Easton, Gabrielle Drake & Carleton Hobbs. The procedure for making Hammonds a public company gets underway. Meanwhile, Jill decides to throw a party. (Drama) - 1974

talkingpictures.uk.title: Saber of London - The Law and the Lawless
talkingpictures.uk.description: Actress Jean White moves to London, but when her mother stops receiving letters she calls on Mark Saber to investigate. (Drama, Crime) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
talkingpictures.uk.description: Kenny Ball sings 'So Do I', Cool Breeze perform 'Reach Out Your Hand', Howard Keel performs 'No Business Like Showbusiness' and 'Oh What A Beautiful Morning'. (Comedy, Music) - 1975

talkingpictures.uk.title: Forever Amber (1947)
talkingpictures.uk.description: In 17th-century England, Amber St. Clair aims to raise herself from country girl to nobility. She follows a travelling soldier to London and succeeds by becoming Charles II's mistress. She loses her true love in the process. (Drama) - 1947

talkingpictures.uk.title: Damn the Defiant! (1962)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An 18th-century ship captain's crew are driven to mutiny by the viciousness of one of the officers, despite the dangers of invasion by the French. (Historical drama) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Great Rupert (1950)
talkingpictures.uk.description: When bookings dry up for his act, Joe Mahoney has to give up his accommodation and free his trained squirrel, Rupert. Vaudeville friends, equally down on their luck, take over Mahoney's rooms. Love is on the cards when the squirrel provides some valuable assistance. (Comedy / Holiday) - 1950

talkingpictures.uk.title: Burke's Law - Who Killed the Swinger on a Hook
talkingpictures.uk.description: A building contractor is found impaled on a meat hook in his own walk-in refrigerator. (Drama, Suspense) - 1964

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Thirteenth Hat
talkingpictures.uk.description: Jervis Tetch, The Mad Hatter, sets out to take revenge against Batman and the 12 members of the jury that convicted him and sent him to prison. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - Batman Stands Pat
talkingpictures.uk.description: Escaping the clutches of The Mad Hatter, Batman and Robin attempt to bring the madman to justice. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes - The Case of the Christmas Pudding
talkingpictures.uk.description: A prisoner escapes shortly after he receives Christmas pudding. (Mystery) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Great Flamarion (1945)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A beautiful female performer manipulates all the men in her life in order to achieve her ambitions. (Drama) - 1945

talkingpictures.uk.title: Miracle on 34th Street (1959)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An old man going by the name of Kris Kringle fills in for an intoxicated Santa in Macy's annual Thanksgiving Day parade. (Drama) - 1959

talkingpictures.uk.title: Railway Murders - The First Railway Murderer
talkingpictures.uk.description: Investigating the most notorious murders ever to take place on the British railways. Nicholas Day narrates the history of blood on the tracks of Britain.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Do You Know This Voice? (1964)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An elderly woman helps trap a kidnapper she has seen make a phone call for ransom. (Crime drama / Mystery / Thriller) - 1964

talkingpictures.uk.title: Mrs. Pym of Scotland Yard (1940)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A woman detective sets about solving the murder of people who have all frequented the same medium. (Crime drama / Mystery) - 1940

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre - Dead Man's Chest
talkingpictures.uk.description: Things go disastrously wrong when two cynical young journalists try to fake a murder. (Drama, Mystery) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood - Secret Mission
talkingpictures.uk.description: The sheriff offers Robin a pardon to fight against King Richard. (Action, Adventure) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Mummy (1959)
talkingpictures.uk.description: An archaeology team discover the tomb of an Egyptian princess, guarded by an undead Mummy who will avenge all who desecrate the site. (Horror) - 1959

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Cheaters - The Hands of Adrian
talkingpictures.uk.description: A violinist is playing in the village and Eastern have insured him. Walter Allan is convinced it is a scam. (Drama, Mystery) - 1962

talkingpictures.uk.title: A Family At War - Giving and Taking
talkingpictures.uk.description: A family in Liverpool deal with WW2, the emphasis being on life on the home front. (Drama, War) - 1971

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look at Life - Through Glass
talkingpictures.uk.description: A look at the interesting profession of window cleaning and the various problems they may face. (Documentary, Community, History) - 1960

talkingpictures.uk.title: Chase a Crooked Shadow (1958)
talkingpictures.uk.description: The arrival of her presumed-dead brother drives an heiress to the brink of insanity. (Thriller) - 1958

talkingpictures.uk.title: Public Eye - Egg and Cress Sandwiches
talkingpictures.uk.description: An unconventional vicar. A breath of scandal and a pillar of the community. All three combine to bring Marker trouble of one kind or another. (Drama, Crime) - 1973

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
talkingpictures.uk.description: On this dark night join Caroline Munro in The Cellar Club as she introduces the Watchers, a science fiction horror from 1988 based on a novel by Dean Koontz. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Watchers (1988)
talkingpictures.uk.description: A government killer follows a smart dog and an orange monster to a boy and his mother. (Horror) - 1988

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro - Outro Week 170
talkingpictures.uk.description: That is all from the Cellar Club tonight and Caroline Munro is here to bring the night to a close. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Executioner (1970)
talkingpictures.uk.description: John Shay, a British spy, suspects that a former colleague was a double agent and starts looking for evidence. Although Shay's superiors warn him against an investigation, he travels to Greece and Turkey in order to check out his suspicions. (Thriller) - 1970

talkingpictures.uk.title: Meet John Doe (1941)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Fired reporter Ann Mitchell runs a final article purportedly from `John Doe' a homeless man planning to hurl himself off a building. The piece causes a storm, and Ann is forced to produce the mysterious Doe, in the shape of washed-up ballplayer John Willoughby. (Drama) - 1941

talkingpictures.uk.title: Scotland Yard - The Case of the River Morgue
talkingpictures.uk.description: he police are summoned when a dead body is stolen. (Crime drama, Suspense) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Vise - Week-End Guest
talkingpictures.uk.description: A young reporter is sent by a London newspaper to interview a woman regarding a celebrated author. (Drama, Crime) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - The Joker Goes to School
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Clown Prince of Crime, The Joker, attempts to undermine student morale at Woodrow Roosevelt High School in order to recruit high school dropouts for his gang of Bad Pennies. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Crime) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman - He Meets His Match, the Grisly Ghoul

talkingpictures.uk.title: Target Earth (1955)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Dragon of Pendragon Castle

talkingpictures.uk.title: Runaround - Episode 25
talkingpictures.uk.description: Prizes include a digital watch and a pocket computer. This episode features small children's kit cars, modern and old model toys, collectible toys and grand prix motorbikes. (Children, Educational, Game show) - 1981

talkingpictures.uk.title: Legend of the Hidden City

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of William Tell - The Young Widow

talkingpictures.uk.title: Hawkeye and the Last of the Mohicans - Winter Passage
talkingpictures.uk.description: Frontier wives hope to join their husbands in time for Christmas. (Action, Adventure, Western) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Lone Ranger - The Lone Ranger's Triumph

talkingpictures.uk.title: Supercar - Flight of Fancy
talkingpictures.uk.description: Jimmy falls asleep reading about the missing princess of Barania. He wakes and decides to steal Supercar to launch a daring rescue operation. Suddenly Mike can speak English and the pair encounter stranger circumstances as the continue their quest. (Fantasy, Science fiction, Children) - 1961

He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behavior puts everyone on edge. They realize too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune -- if they can catch it. (Thriller) - 1997

amc.us.title: The Fly

Unbeknownst to him, a housefly slips in during the process, leading to a merger of man and insect. Initially, Brundle appears to have undergone a successful teleportation, but the fly's cells begin to take over his body. As he becomes increasingly fly-like, Brundle's girlfriend is horrified as the person she once loved deteriorates into a monster. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1986

amc.us.title: House of Wax
amc.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: Poltergeist
amc.us.description: Strange and creepy happenings beset an average California family, the Freelings -- Steve (Craig T. Nelson), Diane (JoBeth Williams), teenaged Dana (Dominique Dunne), eight-year-old Robbie (Oliver Robins), and five-year-old Carol Ann (Heather O'Rourke) -- when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn unexpectedly menacing, and, when Carol Ann goes missing, Steve and Diane turn to a parapsychologist and eventually an exorcist for help. (Horror, Thriller) - 1982

amc.us.title: Carrie
amc.us.description: High school can be tough for many teenagers, but for Carrie White (Chloë Grace Moretz), it's especially hellish. A shy and awkward teen being raised by a religious zealot (Julianne Moore), Carrie is frequently the target of bullies. But Carrie has a secret talent: She can make things move with her mind. One fateful night, an especially cruel prank at her senior prom pushes her over the edge, and Carrie unleashes her telekinetic powers on all who get in her way. (Horror) - 2013

amc.us.title: It
amc.us.description: Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise. (Horror, Thriller) - 2017

amc.us.title: Silver Bullet
amc.us.description: When a series of unexplained murders occurs in the normally quiet town of Tarker's Mill, the residents decide to hunt down the killer. However, many of these vigilantes end up dead, and those who don't are any closer to finding an assailant. But, when a young wheelchair-using boy named Marty encounters a werewolf one night, the pieces begin to come together. Along with his sister and Uncle Red, Marty begins a mission to capture the werewolf once and for all. (Horror) - 1985

amc.us.title: The Shining
amc.us.description: Jack Torrance (Jack Nicholson) becomes winter caretaker at the isolated Overlook Hotel in Colorado, hoping to cure his writer's block. He settles in along with his wife, Wendy (Shelley Duvall), and his son, Danny (Danny Lloyd), who is plagued by psychic premonitions. As Jack's writing goes nowhere and Danny's visions become more disturbing, Jack discovers the hotel's dark secrets and begins to unravel into a homicidal maniac hell-bent on terrorizing his family. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

amc.us.title: Tales From the Crypt - Maniac at Large ᴺᵉʷ
amc.us.description: A librarian fears a serial killer; with Blythe Danner, Adam Ant, Clarence Williams III; director John Frankenheimer. (Horror, Fantasy, Drama, Comedy) - 1992-08-19

amc.us.title: Flight of the Living Dead: Outbreak on a Plane
amc.us.description: A genetically engineered virus turns passengers aboard a 747 into ravenous zombies. (Horror, Thriller) - 2007

comedydynamics.us.title: Josh Blue: Delete
comedydynamics.us.description: In his hometown of Denver, Josh Blue discusses the daily details of his life.

comedydynamics.us.title: Josh Blue: Sticky Change
comedydynamics.us.description: The "Last Comic Standing"-winning comic performs.

comedydynamics.us.title: Kathleen Madigan: Madigan Again
comedydynamics.us.description: Kathleen Madigan performs comedy in Detroit.

comedydynamics.us.title: Kevin Smith: Silent But Deadly Extended Edition
comedydynamics.us.description: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

comedydynamics.us.title: Eddie Griffin: Undeniable
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic celebrates a 30-year anniversary in comedy by discussing the world, relationships and humanity.

comedydynamics.us.title: Eddie Griffin: You Can Tell Em I Said It
comedydynamics.us.description: Eddie shares his thoughts on his love for Michelle Obama, God's sense of humor, who really makes up the Tea Party, and why Cleveland should get over LeBron James.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
comedydynamics.us.description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
comedydynamics.us.description: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: I'm With Cupid
comedydynamics.us.description: Ventriloquist and stand-up comedian Jeff Dunham performs an all-Valentine's Day-themed special.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
comedydynamics.us.description: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

comedydynamics.us.title: Aries Spears: Comedy Blueprint
comedydynamics.us.description: Armed with his ferociously aggressive style of comedy, MAD TV alum Aries Spears takes the stage in Philadelphia for 'Comedy Blueprint.' No one - not black, not white, not gay, not straight - is safe from his jokes and impressions.

comedydynamics.us.title: David Cross: Oh Come On
comedydynamics.us.description: David Cross shares laughter, tears and salty language in this standup special.

comedydynamics.us.title: Erica Rhodes: I Love You More
comedydynamics.us.description: Erica Rhodes has made various stage appearances.

comedydynamics.us.title: Greg Fitzsimmons: Life on Stage
comedydynamics.us.description: Greg Fitzsimmons discusses the joys of life as a baby; how to get a man to do anything you want; an explanation of how we flaunt our good fortune as a nation through water parks.

comedydynamics.us.title: Sam Tallent: Waiting for Death to Claim Us
comedydynamics.us.description: Follows stand-up scion Sam Tallent through 13 different venues across the US from sold-out theaters to house parties and rib-joints, all the while COVID barrels down on the nation in early 2020.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Garcia: Livin The Dream
comedydynamics.us.description: Famed Latino comedian and voiceover artist Jeff Garcia performs his signature improv style at San Manuel Indian Bingo and Casino. He comments on his family, unreliable cars, white people, marriage and his run-ins with the law.

comedydynamics.us.title: Ilana Glazer: The Planet Is Burning
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic shares her thoughts on homophobes, Nazis, women's razors, and what a joke the patriarchy is.

comedydynamics.us.title: Whitney Cummings: Money Shot
comedydynamics.us.description: One of the funniest comics on television.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bill Hicks: Reflections
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedy Dynamics sits down with Bill Hicks' brother, Steve, who tells old stories, squashes old rumors and reveals the brother and son behind the late comedian. Told amidst old and rare footage of Bill.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bill Hicks: One Night Stand
comedydynamics.us.description: Bill Hicks offers his unique take on smoking cigarettes, smoking pot, drinking, sex, advertising and music.

comedydynamics.us.title: Caleb Elliott: Diary of a Smooth Black Kid
comedydynamics.us.description: Caleb Elliot is a young comedian who proves age is anything but a setback.

comedydynamics.us.title: Colin Quinn: Unconstitutional
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian Colin Quinn analyzes the constitutional history of the United States.

comedydynamics.us.title: Eddie Izzard: Circle
comedydynamics.us.description: The show that launched Eddie Izzard's Hollywood career and a seminal performance from one of the foremost stand-ups of his generation recorded live in New York City's Town Hall.

comedydynamics.us.title: Margaret Cho: psyCHO
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic tackles off-limits issues including Boko Haram, racism and her own sexuality.

comedydynamics.us.title: SXSW Comedy With W. Kamau Bell: Part 1
comedydynamics.us.description: Comics perform at the festival; performances include Beth Stelling, Iliza Shlesinger, Mark Normand, Matt Braunger and Nate Bargatze.

comedydynamics.us.title: SXSW Comedy With W. Kamau Bell: Part 2
comedydynamics.us.description: W. Kamau Bell hosts comics at the SXSW Festival; comics include Todd Glass, Wyatt Cenac, Iliza Shlesinger, Rachel Feinstein, Nate Bargatze, Matt Braunger, and Beth Stelling.

comedydynamics.us.title: Shayne Smith: Alligator Boys
comedydynamics.us.description: Comedian Shayne Smith shares stories about everything from a failed robbery to a wrestling match in the New York Subway and even saving the life of a dog in this stand-up special.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bob Saget: That's What I'm Talkin' About
comedydynamics.us.description: Bob Saget takes to the stage with a filthy song in his heart as he lets loose and embraces the dark side as he tells his favorite dirty jokes and stories about his dad - the guy who made him like this.

comedydynamics.us.title: Bob Saget: Zero to Sixty
comedydynamics.us.description: Bob Saget declares himself to be the last TV father viewers can trust in his hour of entertaining stories, riffing with the audience, words of wisdom and new original comedy songs.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jim Gaffigan: Quality Time
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic uses his signature everyman humor to deal with the unthinkable; filmed at the State Theatre in Minneapolis.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jim Gaffigan: Noble Ape
comedydynamics.us.description: Comic Jim Gaffigan proves that laughter is the best medicine when he talks about a family medical crisis and other topics during his hilarious stand-up routine.

comedydynamics.us.title: Lavell Crawford: The Comedy Vaccine (Extended Edition)
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic performs his fifth stand-up comedy special in Tempe, Ariz., focusing on COVID-19 and offering his views on mask culture, fatherhood and why 2020 was the best year to fart in public.

comedydynamics.us.title: Lavell Crawford: New Look Same Funny! (Extended Edition)
comedydynamics.us.description: Lavell Crawford, with a new look and new outlook on life, hosts a new standup special.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
comedydynamics.us.description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
comedydynamics.us.description: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Garcia: Low Budget Madness
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic performs.

comedydynamics.us.title: James Gregory: Food is Not Fatal
comedydynamics.us.description: James Gregory performs standup.

comedydynamics.us.title: Jeff Allen: Honor Thy Wife
comedydynamics.us.description: Jeff Allen, an entertainer, presents a hilarious stand-up comedy act focused on married life.

comedydynamics.us.title: Nick Cannon: Stand Up, Don't Shoot
comedydynamics.us.description: The comic reflects on the times we live in, aging and dating, and the trip to Australia that broke his marriage; from the Ebony Repertory Theatre in South Central Los Angeles.

comedydynamics.us.title: Andy Sandford: &y S&ford
comedydynamics.us.description: Andy Sandford dives into the absurd side of life, tackling pharmacists losing their jobs, full-sized houses on the move, and clowns on the edge. Smart, dry, and brutally funny-this is stand-up for people who notice how weird the world really is.

comedydynamics.us.title: Chris Porter: Ugly and Angry
comedydynamics.us.description: Chris Porter of Last Comic Standing performs his comedy routine in Kansas City.

comedydynamics.us.title: Chris Porter: A Man From Kansas
comedydynamics.us.description: Chris Porter discusses everything from hipsters ruining food, to being a man, to playing beer pong with celebrities, in his 3rd one-hour special.

comedytv.us.title: Funny You Should Ask
comedytv.us.description: Former "Extra" correspondent Jon Kelley hosts this comedy game show that features a panel of comedians interacting with two contestants, who have a chance to win cash if they can read between the lines of the comics' jokes. The contestants ask the comedians questions, to which the jokemakers give humorous answers. The players are tasked with determining if each answer is right or wrong, earning increasingly higher amounts of money as the game progresses. The contestant who has the most money at the end of the game goes on to the bonus round to potentially earn more cash. (Comedy, Game show, Show) - 2017-09-04

The contestants ask the comedians questions, to which the jokemakers give humorous answers. The players are tasked with determining if each answer is right or wrong, earning increasingly higher amounts of money as the game progresses. The contestant who has the most money at the end of the game goes on to the bonus round to potentially earn more cash. (Comedy, Game show, Show) - 2017-09-04

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Stan Utley - Putting Guru
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como visits putting and short game expert Stan Utley in Scottsdale, Arizona. Learn how the putter arch should swing and how to minimize putter face rotation. Plus, Utley demonstrates the best tips for pitch and chip shots.

golfpass.us.description: Chris Como spends a day with rising-star coach Lucas Wald and two of his high profile students, Brandel Chamblee, and Eddie Fernandes. Lucas and Brandel demonstrate the adjustments made to Brandel's swing and how modern golf played its part.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Inside PING HQ

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Jim McLean - X Factor

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Martin Hall - How the Professor Teaches
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como spends a day with "School of Golf" host Martin Hall in his natural habitat; how to visualize the golf swing; how the club path and face affect the swing; how to achieve an ideal impact position; how to find a safe go-to shot.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Driver

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Long Game
golfpass.us.description: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward cover all things long game from fairway metals to hybrids and even how to master the dreaded long irons. They also teach how finding the low point in the swing helps create consistent strikes.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Iron Play
golfpass.us.description: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward explain the big three in iron play: how to control distance, accuracy, and trajectory on shots. They also show a footwork drill to help ball striking and what to do to work the ball into those tucked pins.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Scoring Shots
golfpass.us.description: Andy Proudman and Piers Ward explain how to dial in distances with short irons and how to hit them on line every time; they also explain the bounce angle and how to choose the right amount.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Short Game
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers show how to play a variety of shots around the green, including the high spinning chip, low runner, and many more. They also explain the importance of focusing on a landing zone when hitting greenside shots.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Bunker Play
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers explain the necessary fundamentals to hit effective greenside and fairway bunker shots. They also explain how to hit it close from one of the most feared shots in the game, the 30-40-yard bunker shot.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Putting
golfpass.us.description: Me and My Golf's Andy and Piers explain how to master judging speed and reads on the greens. They also demonstrate the proper mechanics for hitting it solid and making those clutch putts.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - From the Rough
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers explain how to master different lies on the course, featuring the buried lie, sitting up lie, and flyer lie.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Trouble Shots
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers explain that the best play isn't always the hero shot. They demonstrate how save strokes by hitting over, under, and around trouble.

golfpass.us.title: Me and My Golf - Course Management
golfpass.us.description: Andy and Piers explain how to save strokes by thinking around the course; they'll demonstrate how to take advantage of both sides of the tee-box and the importance of a good pre-shot routine.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Rocco Mediate - Full Swing

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Rocco Mediate - Short Game
golfpass.us.description: Rocco Mediate talks the short game and how you can master feel around the greens by using the bounce of your wedge.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Jimmy Walker - Short Game
golfpass.us.description: Jimmy Walker shares tips that helped him become a major champion, specializing on and around the green. Jimmy discusses the keys to greenside bunker play, teaches how to chip it close with the wedge, and reveals how an alignment rod helps sink putts.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Jimmy Walker - Distance
golfpass.us.description: Jimmy Walker talks all aspects of distance, bringing out the driver to show how to gain distance off the tee and how to tone it down.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Jimmy Walker - Full Swing
golfpass.us.description: Major champion Jimmy Walker breaks down all things full swing to show what has led him to multiple victories on the PGA TOUR. He highlights the trials, tribulations, and ultimately the rewards of implementing major swing changes.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Graeme McDowell - Short Game
golfpass.us.description: U.S. Open and PGA Tour winner Graeme McDowell shares trade secrets on all things short game. McDowell gives step-by-step instructions on hitting off different surfaces and demonstrates how to make more putts with a simple, yet effective trigger.

golfpass.us.title: Golf Channel Academy - Graeme McDowell - Full Swing
golfpass.us.description: U.S. Open winner Graeme McDowell goes in depth on the fundamentals and key traits of the full swing. McDowell gives step-by-step instructions on how to shape shots, consistently hit accurate tee shots, and use body rotation to achieve proper timing.

syfywest.us.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre: The Next Generation

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty Don visits two sets of ambitious gardeners, each facing challenges on a very different scale. One is a tiny urban courtyard in Hackney and the other is a outdoor area for a community.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty meets two sets of gardeners who have unimaginable ambitions for their outdoor spaces. In Essex Denise has never ventured beyond the decking area behind her house. Meanwhile in Ipswich, a father and daughter plan to build a terraced allotment.

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Monty comes to the rescue of two couples in need of help transforming their rubble filled back gardens into havens of peace and tranquillity. They are in serious need of help and advice but can Monty set them on the right track?

700407.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
700407.description: Two gardeners, each living on their own, are hoping Monty can help them. In Blackpool, Alex dreams of turning her boring back yard into a magical enchanted forest. Also in Bristol, Ross has taken on a very over-grown allotment.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Adam Frost is at home sharing his love of ornamental grasses, tackling the problem of building a patio on a slope and giving some inspiration on what to plant at the base of a wall. In Margate, the team visit a man who has come up with a unique way of using a shed roof to grow vegetables, and they travel to Swansea to meet inspirational gardener Sue Kent, who shows how she has designed her garden to enable her to garden successfully despite her upper limb difference.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty plants for pollinators in the Wildlife Garden and trims his box topiary cones. He also takes succulent leaf cuttings and continues the summer veg harvest. Meanwhile, Carol Klein visits stunning Italian-influenced gardens in Gloucestershire.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty Don is at Longmeadow with a host of seasonal jobs to keep his autumn garden looking beautiful for as long as possible, and in the third of her fascinating films about how plants work, Carol Klein investigates the science of stems.

700407.title: Gardeners' World
700407.description: Monty has tips and ideas for planting up garden pots to provide a focal point over the winter months, Rachel visits the tulips of Keukenhof, Joe visits Esther Rantzen's much-loved garden, and Carol visits Glebe Cottage.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Rhiannon and Chris need the team's help with their new-build garden. It's dull and boring with nowhere to sit, no shade, and it's dominated by two huge garage walls, which flank it on either side. Lee and Flo have a budget of £3,500 to work with.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Stratford, Simon and Steve want a stylish garden with dramatic twists, suitable for the home town of William Shakespeare. Can the team come up with something that is stylishly modern with hints of Tudor heritage?

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Danielle and Andy in Teignmouth have a wonderful opportunity to create a delightful terraced garden in the back of their smart new home. The only problem is, they don't have the green fingers to do their garden justice.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: Steve and Alice are after an Ibiza-flavoured outdoor space inspired by Alice's past living abroad. They have a budget of £2,500 and want a garden that will do justice to their new kitchen extension that spills outdoors through large bi-fold doors.

700407.title: Garden Rescue
700407.description: In Stowmarket, Charlie and the Rich brothers have to turn a total concrete jungle into a family-friendly back garden for Jason, Esther, and their kids. The couple have a budget of £3,000 to create a space where they can enjoy sitting out as a family.

700407.title: Monty Don's Japanese Gardens

673498.title: The Nebraskan
673498.description: When his Indian assistant, Wingfoot (Maurice Jara), is accused of murdering a Sioux chief, Army scout Wade Harper (Phil Carey) brings him to Fort Kearney, Neb., where Colonel Markham (Regis Toomey) insists the young man has the right to a fair trial rather than handing him over to the Sioux. While in jail, Wingfoot is forced to escape with ruthless prisoner Reno Benton (Lee Van Cleef). Wade sets out with a small party to rescue his friend, with the Sioux right behind him.

673498.title: The Kid From Broken Gun
673498.description: After years on the East Coast, former boxer Jack Mahoney (Jack Mahoney) returns to New Mexico and finds himself framed for murder. Though the only evidence is circumstantial, in the face of vicious prosecutor Kiefer (Myron Healey), Mahoney's girlfriend -- defense lawyer Gail Kingston (Angela Stevens) -- fails to convince the jury of his innocence. Determined to clear Mahoney's name, postal worker Steve Reynolds (Charles Starrett) transforms himself into the masked rider known as the Durango Kid.

673498.title: The Professionals
673498.description: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band as to whether they should honor their agreement.

673498.title: The Gun That Won the West
673498.description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

673498.title: Blazing the Western Trail
673498.description: Noble cowboy the Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) gets snared in a vicious feud between two warring stagecoach operations. One of the two has been recently willed to spitfire Mary Halliday (Carole Mathews), whose father the Kid suspects was murdered by a business rival. With the help of his trusted friends Tex Harding (Tex Harding) and Cannonball (Dub Taylor), the Kid hopes to uncover the truth while hiding the investigation from the strident Miss Halliday.

673498.title: Rio Grande
673498.description: The conniving Ed Barker (Dick Curtis) murders a rancher and tries to steal the ranch from his widow, Jean Andrews (Ann Doran). However, their old friend Cliff Houston (Charles Starrett) appears on the scene to try and save the day. He makes a deal with Barker and his crew to drive the Andrews herd to market and split the money, but each man really plans to con the other as soon as the time is right. Along for the ride is singing cowboy Bob Stevens (Bob Nolan).

673498.title: Relentless
673498.description: Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.

673498.title: The Prescott Kid
673498.description: A cowboy finds himself in serious trouble with a notorious outlaw.

673498.title: The Desert Horseman
673498.description: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) catch up to payroll robbers.

673498.title: Streets of Ghost Town
673498.description: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) look for stolen gold with a history.

673498.title: Alvarez Kelly
673498.description: Alvarez Kelly (William Holden) is a Mexican cattle rancher who is doing his best to stay out of the Civil War. He has no interest in which side may win or lose -- Kelly is far more concerned about his own survival, and about making money. He soon finds himself in the middle of the conflict, however, when a confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) captures the rancher and forces Kelly to help his soldiers steal a nearby herd of cattle, which they desperately need for food.

673500.title: Gidget
673500.description: A self-conscious teen gains confidence when two surfers show interest, challenging her insecurities and changing how she sees herself.

673500.title: Born Yesterday
673500.description: Brassy blonde moll Billie Dawn (Judy Holliday) hits Washington, D.C., with her unscrupulous millionaire sugar daddy, Harry Brock (Broderick Crawford), and his sleazy lawyer, Jim Devery (Howard St. John), who has been pressuring Harry to marry Billie by pointing out that a wife cannot be forced to testify against her husband. In an effort to make Billie more socially acceptable, Harry hires journalist Paul Verrall (William Holden) to smarten her up -- and sparks soon fly between the pair.

673500.title: Scandal Sheet
673500.description: After accidentally killing his ex-wife, an editor of a tabloid newspaper discovers that his ace reporters are investigating the story.

673500.title: Diamond Head
673500.description: A wealthy Hawaiian pineapple plantation owner and bigoted bully with political ambitions flatly refuses to allow his young sister to marry a native.

673500.title: The Happy Time
673500.description: A large French-Canadian family suddenly expands when father Jacques (Charles Boyer) invites an out-of-work magician's assistant to be their live-in maid. At the same time, charming ladies' man Uncle Desmond (Louis Jourdan) comes back to town to replace a sales manager who has died, and subsequently begins a romance with the new maid. Jacques' son Bobby watches these interactions with confused curiosity as he makes the tough transition from boyhood to adolescence.

673500.title: Tight Spot
673500.description: A lawyer springs a wise-cracking model from jail to convince her to testify against a no-good mobster, but a besotted cop throws a wrench in the plan.

673500.title: You Can't Take It With You
673500.description: Sweet-natured Alice Sycamore (Jean Arthur) falls for banker's son Tony Kirby (James Stewart). But when she invites her snooty prospective in-laws to dinner to give their blessing to the marriage, Alice's peculiar extended family -- including philosophical grandfather Martin Vanderhof (Lionel Barrymore), hapless fledgling ballerina sister Essie (Ann Miller) and fireworks enthusiast father, Paul (Samuel S. Hinds) -- might be too eccentric for the staid Kirbys.

673500.title: The Fuller Brush Girl

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 3, 1990, a 14-year-old girl ran away from her mother's home and disappeared without a trace. Her mother hoped Pasadena, Texas police could find her before it was too late. Six months later, their worst fear was realized when a farmer discovered the young girl's remains in an Illinois barn. The FBI was called in to help. Agents tracked down a trucker who they believed was responsible for 50 more deaths. Investigators knew they had to stop this menace of the highways.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: He wandered the streets of New York City wearing only pajamas and a bathrobe, but the FBI was convinced that Vince Gigante, the reputed boss of the Genovese crime family, was anything but crazy. The FBI used undercover surveillance, secret audio tapes, six mobsters turned government informants and the testimony of twelve FBI agents to help convict Gigante of murder and conspiracy-to-murder, including a plot to kill rival mob boss John Gotti.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: The rapes and murders of ten women near Tampa, Florida in 1984 had the authorities puzzled and the community scared. Since the beginning, the FBI had been analyzing the crime scene evidence and had found a common link: red trilobal carpet fibers. But there was no suspect, until one of the killer's potential victims survived. Through her interviews and the cooperation of local authorities and the FBI, 31-year-old Bobby Joe Long emerged as the prime suspect.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: Claude Dallas lived the life of a cowboy. A loner and distrustful of authority, he lived off the land, poaching wildlife and selling the hides. But when two game wardens confronted Dallas about his deeds, they were shot and killed. After a massive manhunt, Dallas was captured and convicted, only to escape months later. Making the FBI's Ten Most Wanted list, Dallas eluded the law for almost a year until the FBI tracked him down in a small town in California.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: He was a recluse who spread terror through the mail for 18 years. Two men died and more than a dozen were injured, but Ted Kaczynski wasn't known as the Unabomber until his brother tipped off the FBI. Kaczynski's “Unabomber Manifesto,” published in major newspapers, set off a flurry of activity for the FBI: writing analysis and comparisons, DNA gleaned from a single postage stamp and finally, Kaczynski's arrest at his tiny cabin.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: When five-year-old Melissa Brannen disappeared from a Christmas party in December 1989, the only probable suspect was 24-year-old Caleb Hughes. Hughes reportedly left the party around the time Melissa vanished, but no one saw him with the girl. Fifty blue acrylic fibers collected during a search of Hughes' car, however, became the major piece of evidence in the case. FBI fiber analysis determined that those fibers were identical to the ones that made up the sweater Melissa was wearing.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: On February 26, 1993, an explosion rocked the World Trade Center parking garage. Six people died and more than a thousand were injured in the bomb blast that tore a 5-story crater in the building. During the investigation, the twisted fender of a rental van was extracted from the rubble. The FBI was able to determine from where the van was rented and by whom. Undercover agents then made their arrests within six days of the bombing.

Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Docudrama, Adventure) - 2012

The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. cinemax.us.title: A Thousand Words
cinemax.us.description: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech, or he's a goner. (Comedy) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: The Man Who Invented Christmas
cinemax.us.description: In 1843 London, author Charles Dickens finds himself in financial trouble after writing three unsuccessful novels in a row. Desperate for a hit, Dickens relies on real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination to bring Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in A Christmas Carol, forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today. (Holiday, Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
cinemax.us.description: Ten-year-old Gloria and her recently widowed grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home. They try to keep the secret while figuring out why the reindeer has appeared, and longstanding rifts within the family are healed along the way. (Family, Holiday, Drama, Fantasy) - 2022

cinemax.us.title: Brian Banks
cinemax.us.description: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL. (Biography, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Hidden Figures
cinemax.us.description: Three brilliant African American women at NASA, Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson, serve as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history, the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit, a stunning achievement that restored the nation's confidence, turned around the Space Race and galvanized the world. (Historical drama, Docudrama, Biography) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Inconceivable
cinemax.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Robin Hood
cinemax.us.description: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power. - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Men
cinemax.us.description: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. - 2022

cinemax.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
cinemax.us.description: Former special-operations mercenary Frank Martin (Ed Skrein) utilizes his covert skills when a femme fatale (Loan Chabanol) uses him as a pawn in her vengeful scheme against the human trafficker (Camille Delamarre) who victimized her years earlier. - 2015

cinemax.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemax.us.description: Vicious criminals continue to harass a man (Viggo Mortensen) and his wife (Maria Bello) after he thwarts a robbery attempt at his diner. - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Trap
cinemax.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Aftermath
cinemax.us.description: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter. (Thriller, Drama, Action) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Room
cinemax.us.description: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time. (Drama, Thriller) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
cinemax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Fantastic Beasts: A Natural History
cinemax.us.description: Delving into the mythological, including dragons, mermaids, and unicorns -- alongside examinations of natural world beasts, such as vervet monkeys, narwhals, and manatees; Stephen Fry travels far and wide to learn about such animals. (Special, Documentary, Nature) - 2022-02-27

cinemax.us.title: The Hobbit
cinemax.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. (Animated, Fantasy) - 1977

cinemax.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
cinemax.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Batman
cinemax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

cinemax.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman.
