Then mysterious Steven Francis Howard (Michael North) arrives, claiming to be the husband of Grandison's niece -- who was thought dead in a shipwreck. Howard begins looking into the suicide and soon brings to light new evidence. (Crime drama) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Smart Woman
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A special prosecutor (Brian Aherne) falls in love with the lawyer (Constance Bennett) he opposes in a racketeer's murder trial. - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Topper
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The ghosts of socialites George (Cary Grant) and Marion (Constance Bennett) decide to help their friend, banker Cosmo Topper (Roland Young). - 1937

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Topper Takes a Trip
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The ghosts of socialite Marion (Constance Bennett) and her dog, Skippy, help Cosmo Topper (Roland Young) with his wife (Billie Burke) on the Riviera. - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Snake Pit
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A man (Mark Stevens) commits his wife (Olivia de Havilland) to a mental hospital, where her doctor (Leo Genn) tries the latest therapy. - 1948

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Suddenly, Last Summer
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this adaptation of Tennessee Williams' play, young socialite Catherine Holly (Elizabeth Taylor) is traumatized and committed after witnessing her cousin's violent death on a trip to Europe. Her aunt, Violet Venable (Katharine Hepburn), wants to hide the events of her son's death and attempts to bribe young surgeon Dr. John Cukrowicz (Montgomery Clift) to perform a lobotomy on Catherine. But John vows to find out the truth about Catherine's state before taking any action. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 1959

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Torture Garden
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Sideshow psychic Dr. Diabolo (Burgess Meredith) predicts the horrific futures of some curious fairground visitors. Wealthy Colin (Michael Bryant) finds himself compelled to murder. Ruthless actress Carla (Beverly Adams) discovers that movie stars have a shocking secret. Lovestruck reporter Dorothy (Barbara Ewing) does battle with the spirit of her beloved's dead mother. And greedy Edgar Allan Poe collector Ronald (Jack Palance) finds out a horrifying truth about his idol after murdering a rival. (Horror) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: From Beyond the Grave
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The sinister owner (Peter Cushing) of a London antiques shop leads customers into four tales of terror. (Horror, Comedy drama, Crime drama, Docudrama, Drama) - 1973

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Kwaidan
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Taking its title from an archaic Japanese word meaning "ghost story," this anthology adapts four folk tales. A penniless samurai (Rentarô Mikuni) marries for money with tragic results. A man stranded in a blizzard is saved by Yuki the Snow Maiden (Keiko Kishi), but his rescue comes at a cost. Blind musician Hoichi (Katsuo Nakamura) is forced to perform for an audience of ghosts. An author (Osamu Takizawa) relates the story of a samurai who sees another warrior's reflection in his teacup. (Horror, Fantasy) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Three Cases of Murder
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The first in this triptych of strange tales centers on a museum worker (Hugh Pryse), who discovers he can wander into the paintings he guards. Next, George (Emrys Jones) becomes rivals with a friend when they fall for the same girl (Elizabeth Sellars), but things turn dark when she turns up dead. Finally, after the powerful Lord Mountdrago (Orson Welles) ruins a politician's career during a heated debate, the ruined man (Alan Badel) seeks revenge by attacking Mountdrago in his dreams. (Horror) - 1953

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Painted Desert
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Hugh buys the deed to the Banning mine, and sells it to Bob when he thinks it is worthless. When he learns the mine is full of tungsten, he sets out to get it back. (Western) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Powdersmoke Range
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The Three Mesquiteers (Harry Carey, Hoot Gibson, Guinn Williams) fight a gambler and his henchmen for a ranch. (Western) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Yellow Dust
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A prospector goes undercover to clear his name of robbery before he can lay claim to a mother lode of gold. (Western) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Arizonian
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A marshal, trying to end lawlessness and protect his brother and sweetheart, fights it out with a gang of crooks. (Western) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cimarron
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1889, adventurous lawyer and newspaper editor Yancey Cravat (Richard Dix) convinces his genteel wife, Sabra (Irene Dunne), to join him in the rush to populate Osage, Oklahoma. After they begin to settle into the community, Yancey leaves to go further west. Alone, Sabra inherits his editorial duties and struggles to bring civilization to the rough frontier town. Over a tumultuous 40 years, the couple are repeatedly separated and reunited as Oklahoma makes its long journey to statehood. (Western) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Ghost Valley
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A crooked judge (Mitchell Harris) unwittingly hires the heir to a gold mine to scare his cousin (Merna Kennedy) into selling the property. (Western, Romance) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Annie Oakley
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Expert markswoman Annie Oakley (Barbara Stanwyck) leaves her backwoods home to challenge New York's vaudeville sharpshooter, Toby Walker (Preston Foster). Toby is skeptical of Annie's skill, but although she purposely loses their contest, the business partner of Buffalo Bill Cody (Moroni Olsen) realizes her potential. Cody builds an act for his Wild West show around Annie and Toby's rivalry, but it is threatened by their acquaintance with native Chief Sitting Bull, and a challenge for Toby. (Western) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Scarlet River
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An actor (Tom Keene) on the set of a cowboy movie rescues a rancher (Dorothy Wilson) from her foreman (Creighton Chaney). (Western) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Carl Laemmle
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The extraordinary life story of Carl Laemmle, the German-Jewish immigrant who founded Universal Pictures and saved over 300 Jewish families from Nazi Germany. (Documentary) - 2019

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Frankenstein
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This iconic horror film follows the obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein as he attempts to create life by assembling a creature from body parts of the deceased. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it escapes into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc. Frankenstein searches for the elusive being and eventually must confront his tormented creation. (Horror) - 1931

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Invisible Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: While researching a new drug, Dr. Jack Griffin (Claude Rains) stumbles on a potion that can make him invisible. When he reveals his new ability to his old mentor (Henry Travers) and his fiancée (Gloria Stuart), it's clear that a side effect of the potion is insanity. Jack goes on a violent rampage, and the police struggle to hunt him down, unable to see their target, while his mentor and his former partner (William Harrigan) desperately try to devise a plan to capture him. (Science fiction) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Black Cat
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Stranded Budapest honeymooners follow a mad doctor (Bela Lugosi) to a black-lipped architect's (Boris Karloff) Art Deco manor. (Horror) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Posing for a portrait, Dorian Gray (Hurd Hatfield) talks with Lord Henry Wotton (George Sanders), who says that men should pursue their sensual longings, but laments that only the young get to do so. Taken with the idea, Dorian imagines a scenario in which the painting will age as he stays youthful. His wish comes true, and his boyish looks aid him as he indulges his every whim. But when a stunning revelation forces him to see what he's become, Dorian faces some very dangerous questions. (Horror) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Beast With Five Fingers
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Astrologist Hilary Cummins (Peter Lorre) works as a personal assistant to the eccentric and mostly paralyzed pianist, Francis Ingram (Victor Francen). A nurse, Julie Holden (Andrea King) also lives at the Italian villa to help care for Ingram, who plays the piano with only his undamaged left hand. Following a visit from a scam artist (Robert Alda), Ingram crashes down the stairs to his death -- and a plague of bizarre events ensues that are attributed to the musician's disembodied left hand. (Horror) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cat People
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Irena Dubrovna (Simone Simon), a New York City–based fashion designer who hails from Serbia, begins a romance with marine engineer Oliver Reed (Kent Smith). After the couple gets married, Oliver becomes concerned about Irena's notion that she is cursed and may transform into a large cat in the heat of passion. Confiding in his beautiful assistant, Alice Moore (Jane Randolph), about his marital issues, Oliver unwittingly triggers Irena's curse, with tragic results. (Horror) - 1942

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paddock To Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Barossa Valley & Adelaide Hill Matt Moran heads to South Australia's Barossa Valley and Adelaide Hills, meeting up with Maggie Beer, marking the 60th anniversary of Henschke's Mount Edelstone Shiraz.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E9 New Orleans Tony heads to New Orleans for 36 hours in effort to drink, eat and experience as much of the city as he can handle. From Cajun classics to classic cocktails, this layover is packed with the best food.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Amalul's Pandan Bubble Tea Amalul, Alimah's granddaughter, is a self-proclaimed bubble tea connoisseur. She shares her bright bubble tea brew and pays tribute to the vibrant and flavourful pandanus leaf.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E76 Signature Supper Discover how Adam, chef Jason Barratt and comedian Anisa Nandaula impress without the stress, as they share their signature supper recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E2 Stockholm: Big City For Foodies When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he encounters innovation and world class gastronomy. He makes pizza at the Rosendal garden cafe and goes on an adventure in the archipielago.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E12 Rhubarb Rhubarb is finally having a resurgence! This is good news for the UK as historically they grow some of the best rhubarb in the world.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E14 My Fruit Trees Lidia's fig tree reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. She makes roasted pork loin with dried cherry sauce, then fennel and Asian pear salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Justine visits Kakadu, Katherine and Edith Falls uncovering Katherine's best coffee, Justine whips up a sweet trifle treat at Edith Falls and sources some native herbs and fruits to try.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Analiese makes the most of a busy spring as she starts to build her pantry and kitchen garden, before going diving for wild scallops at a friend's secret diving spot.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paddock To Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Barossa Valley & Adelaide Hill Matt Moran heads to South Australia's Barossa Valley and Adelaide Hills, meeting up with Maggie Beer, marking the 60th anniversary of Henschke's Mount Edelstone Shiraz.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E76 Signature Supper Discover how Adam, chef Jason Barratt and comedian Anisa Nandaula impress without the stress, as they share their signature supper recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S5 E2 Stockholm: Big City For Foodies When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he encounters innovation and world class gastronomy. He makes pizza at the Rosendal garden cafe and goes on an adventure in the archipielago.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Percorino Pecorino is one of the most ancient of all European cheeses. Will explains the different types before travelling to Tuscany to visit the 'Il Forteto' dairy.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Menu Six Mark compiles his ultimate dinner party recipes. To begin, a mushroom parmesan spaghetti, then a classic tiramisu. In Mark's 'How To Perfect' features, he demonstrates on how to cook the perfect steak.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Posh Nosh Tonight's show is packed full of ideas for posh nosh. So whether you're throwing a dinner party or just want to rustle up something a bit more special, Lorraine has it covered.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Bread And Pizza Sophie explores the traditional taralli biscuits made of wine and olive oil, goes in search of the perfect pizza and makes her own in the outdoor pizza oven.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Lloyd Pigram: Pork Adobo & Boab Custard With Bush Passionfruit Topping Lloyd draws on his Filipino heritage and his Auntie's recipe for this locally loved dish with a humble bush fruit Boab to make a custard, and a bush passionfruit topping.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 A Late Summer Lunch Maggie and Simon show their different approaches to cooking. Maggie cooks a hearty meal for the family, while Simon gives a restaurant touch to his meal.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E19 Episode 19 Laura visits the beautiful Adelaide Hills and cooks a Greek favourite, Spanakopita.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E19 Sardine Pasta Rachael prepares her favourite Sicilian dish, pasta con le sarde, or sardine pasta, using both canned fish and fresh sardines atop long-cut pasta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E1 Sunny Coast Hayden heads to Queensland's Sunshine Coast, where golden beaches meet vibrant hinterland farms. He meets passionate local producers, samples the region's freshest flavours, and soaks up the lifestyle.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E9 Episode 9 Khanh Ong whips up an addictive crispy Cinnamon Condensed Milk Filo Pie.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E14 Episode 14 From the iconic fresh food markets, 2025 MasterChef winner Laura Sharrad hosts My Market Kitchen with loads of delicious recipes, plenty of guests and a few surprises.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E12 Episode 12 Samantha Petter's family-run organic cobnut orchard near Sevenoaks in Kent provides vital ingredients for Sprats with a Cobnut Pesto.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E43 Episode 43 Justine and Jo bring a little sweetness to today's show with a Macadamia Swiss Roll with Wattleseed and Chocolate and Berry and Coconut Fool. Justine switches things up with Tuna and Potato Gratin.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E76 Signature Supper Discover how Adam, chef Jason Barratt and comedian Anisa Nandaula impress without the stress, as they share their signature supper recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E13 Asparagus English asparagus is world renowned and with a short six week season, something to really treasure.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E15 The 1970s Italian American Lidia honours the Italian American culinary culture and prepares a chicken parmigiana, a leftover meatball panino, and a baked tomato pasta, then meatballs, and eggs.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Camembert Camembert is a potent symbol of French cheese making and is copied all over the world. Will visits the tiny village of Camembert where it all began, and the nearby dairy of Monsieur Durand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: What Chefs Want
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Feast For The Senses Immerse yourself in the delights of Singapore's food festivals with the Marina Bay Sands Food and Wine festival. Sally and Renae explore its culinary scene, interviewing a Michelin-star chef.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Everyday Easy In the final episode, Lorraine makes easy, delicious dishes that you can rustle up every day. There's pan fried pork chops with a watercress, peach & stilton salad and a lemon ginger dressing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Olives: The Elixir Of Life Puglia is one of the biggest producers of olive oil. At home, Sophie serves up a chocolate mousse with olive oil - a dish new to her Puglian neighbours.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 Ali & Mitch Torres: Chilli Tamarind Jinnup (Stingray) & Cockle Salad Inspired by their mother's cooking, Ali and Mitch prepare two seafood dishes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Dinner Party For 6 Maggie Beer and Simon Bryant invite us into the kitchen to share the secrets to having friends for dinner without fuss or failure - but with a little drama and presentation.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E20 Episode 20 Our favourite nutritionist, Simone, joins Laura in the market as they put together a delicious and nutritious Salmon Poke Bowl.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E20 Pantry Meal With Sarah Moulton Author and chef Sarah Moulton joins Rachael in her Tuscan kitchen for a cooking challenge. Both Rachael and Sarah create 'mystery meals' using ingredients from Rachael's Tuscan pantry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E2 Mackay Isaac Region Hayden ventures off the beaten track into the Mackay Isaac region, discovering pristine landscapes, remote fishing spots, and remarkable food producers who make this hidden corner of Australia.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E10 Episode 10 Here's what's coming up on today's show. Gabriel Gates bakes us a sublime Apple and Calvados Cake. Justine has the perfect Cappuccino Mousse.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E15 Episode 15 Laura whips up mushroom curry, Thai beef salad and manicotti, while Catherine serves Persian-style potatoes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E13 Episode 13 Rick and Chalky enjoy Irish hospitality, sampling herb celery around Strangford Lough, and monkfish and mussels in Southern Ireland. Fresh oysters and organic kale complete this Irish culinary tour.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E44 Episode 44 There's brulee and then there's Earl Grey and Berry Tea Brulee with Rhubarb Compote: guest Jeremy Bentley gets creative with this one. Justine makes her winter warmer Chicken and Mushroom Cottage pie.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E77 Simple & Scrumptious It's a night of simple and scrumptious food, as Adam is joined by two sensational chefs, Zoe Birch from Greasy Zoe's and Chung Jae Lee from Seoul Sisters.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Beyond Bali With Lara Lee
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 West Flores Mountains: Manggarai Culture And Cooking High in the mountains of Flores, Lara Lee discovers ancestral food traditions, soul-stirring hospitality and the delicious charm of slow food from bamboo feasts & barefoot farming to pineapple sambal.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: How Do They Really Do It?
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Nando's Nando's restaurants have become a common sight on our high streets. Get some insight from former employees and industry experts to find out how it became a popular diner destination in the UK.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Tohoku Adam Liaw goes to sea with the Japanese fishermen who caught the 'million dollar tuna', and then meets the soy sauce maker who saved most of his staff from the 2011 tsunami.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E10 Seattle Tony has 48 hours in Seattle. First stop: a 'proper hunk of bleeding meat' at Canlis, then an artisanal cheese binge at Calf and Kid, followed by oysters at Walrus and the Carpenter.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Island Dreams No-Rice \ This pudding is a family favourite and represents how resourceful the people of the Cocos Islands are. Alimah Bilda shares a recipe passed down from her mother.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Down Under Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Australia and New Zealand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nadiya's Party Feasts
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Nadiya Hussain is throwing a party and we're all invited! She shares her secrets for the perfect celebration - whether it's dishes to put in the middle or delicious nibbles. Nobody will want to leave!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marcus In The Med: Mallorca
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Fiesta Food Marcus is discovering what Mallorcans like to feast on for a special occasion. He discovers some amazing cakes at a traditional bakery in Palma, then makes his own version of almond cake.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A New Zealand Food Story
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E6 Episode 6 It's stone fruit season! Ben visits a family run orchard in Central Otago known for its long season of stone fruit and a strong connection to the land and community.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: David Rocco's Eating Dirty
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Bowls, Brains And Gold Of The Sea This time on Eating Dirty, David experiences the heavy carbs and crazy lunchtime antics in one of Naples' most famous restaurants.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Global Soul Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Cajun Chicken Confit With Pickled Fennel Chef Deborah VanTrece prepares her Southern-style chicken confit by seasoning the chicken, adding vegetables and herbs, and slow-cooking it in oil.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jeremy Pang's Hong Kong Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Nisha Katona Jeremy teams up with his good friend and TV chef Nisha Katona to explore Hong Kong's vibrant international food scene.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Inside Sydney Fish Market
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 An Open Market The new market finally opens. As huge crowds try out its restaurants, loading docks and high-tech systems, veteran fisherman Paul Bagnato battles rough seas to supply its first auctions.

fxm.us.title: High Anxiety
fxm.us.description: Just after becoming the director of the Psychoneurotic Institute for the Very, Very Nervous, Dr. Richard H. Thorndyke is greeted by a series of mysterious events. When his colleagues -- including the militaristic and mustachioed Nurse Diesel -- become leery of his questions, they accuse him of murder. Thorndyke's own mental health comes into question as he struggles to clear his name in the midst of a crippling bout of a condition known as high anxiety. (Comedy) - 1977

fxm.us.title: The Hot Rock
fxm.us.description: A man and his brother-in-law plan to steal a priceless diamond from the Brooklyn Museum. Helped by an expert getaway man and an explosives wizard, the daring duo steal the gem with a little assistance from bombs, a faked car crash and a little dressing up as uniformed guards and doctors. However, almost as soon as they get their hands on the loot and prepare to transfer it to an African diplomat, they lose it. (Comedy) - 1972

fxm.us.title: Eyewitness
fxm.us.description: New York City custodian Daryll Deever (William Hurt) is a big fan of local news reporter Tony Sokolow (Sigourney Weaver), so he is intrigued when she shows up to cover a story at his workplace. There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden. (Thriller) - 1981

fxm.us.title: Working Girl
fxm.us.description: Savvy New York City receptionist Tess McGill (Melanie Griffith) gives her conniving boss, Katharine Parker (Sigourney Weaver), an excellent business tip, but Katharine simply steals the idea without giving due credit to her secretary. After Katharine winds up in the hospital with an injured leg, Tess decides to exact revenge. Pretending to be her boss, Tess initiates a major deal with an investment broker (Harrison Ford) -- but things turn ugly after Katharine finds out what Tess has been up to. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 1988

fxm.us.title: Alien
fxm.us.description: In deep space, the crew of the commercial starship Nostromo is awakened from their cryo-sleep capsules halfway through their journey home to investigate a distress call from an alien vessel. The terror begins when the crew encounters a nest of eggs inside the alien ship. An organism from inside an egg leaps out and attaches itself to one of the crew, causing him to fall into a coma. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1979

But even these battle-hardened marines with all the latest weaponry are no match for the hundreds of aliens that have invaded the colony. (Science fiction, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 1986

Once again, Ripley must face skepticism and the alien as it hunts down the prisoners and guards. Without weapons or modern technology of any kind, Ripley leads the men into battle against the terrifying creature. (Science fiction, Horror) - 1992

fxm.us.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
fxm.us.description: When a UFO lands in Washington, D.C., bearing a message for Earth's leaders, all of humanity stands still. Klaatu has come on behalf of alien life who have been watching Cold War-era nuclear proliferation on Earth. But it is Klaatu's soft-spoken robot Gort that presents a more immediate threat to onlookers. A single mother and her son teach the world about peace and tolerance in this moral fable, ousting the tanks and soldiers that greet the alien's arrival. (Science fiction) - 1951

Larry hopes to score enough to buy his ideal car, and then join the professional league. At the last minute, their heist is complicated by the addition of Larry's on-off girlfriend (Susan George), who's all jazzed up for the burglary. Larry's racing skills will be pushed to the limit in this chase-packed action thriller. (Action) - 1974

What they find instead is a Satanic cult sacrifice, and they are unfortunate enough to be caught observing the ritual. Naturally, this doesn't sit too well with the cult members. Now Roger and Frank are on the run from what is apparently a very sizable Texan Satanist community. (Horror) - 1975

Tough Scandinavian operative Nils Tahlvik (Sean Connery) is sent in to deal with the armed men and free the aircraft's passengers. Unfortunately for Tahlvik, the terrorists prove to be quite formidable. Meanwhile, another unit of the same extremist organization is holding an English ambassador hostage, which further complicates matters. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1974

babytv.us.title: Mona and Sketch
babytv.us.description: Mona is a curious and adventurous girl who has a very special friend called Sketch; Mona uses her imagination to figure out what she wants to be when she grows up and Sketch helps her by using his artistic skills.

bbcamerica.us.title: Nature's Great Events - The Great Melt
bbcamerica.us.description: The summer melt of Arctic ice provides opportunities for millions of animals, but grave dangers for others, including polar bears. (Documentary, Nature) - 2009-02-11

bbcamerica.us.title: Creepshow
bbcamerica.us.description: A compendium of five short but terrifying tales contained within a single full-length feature, this film conjures scares from traditional bogeymen and portents of doom. In one story, a monster escapes from its holding cell. Another focuses on a husband (Leslie Nielsen) with a creative way of getting back at his cheating wife. Other stories concern a rural man (Stephen King) and a visitor from outer space, and a homeowner (E.G. Marshall) with huge bug problems and a boozing corpse. (Horror, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1982

bbcamerica.us.title: Leprechaun
bbcamerica.us.description: Dan O'Grady (Shay Duffin) steals 100 gold coins from a leprechaun (Warwick Davis) while on vacation in Ireland. The leprechaun follows him home, but Dan locks the murderous midget in a crate, held at bay by a four-leaf clover. Ten years later, J.D. Redding (John Sanderford) and his daughter, Tory (Jennifer Aniston), rent O'Grady's property for the summer. When their new neighbors accidentally release the leprechaun, he goes on a murderous rampage to reclaim his gold. (Horror, Comedy) - 1993

bbcamerica.us.title: Arachnophobia
bbcamerica.us.description: After a nature photographer (Mark L. Taylor) dies on assignment in Venezuela, a poisonous spider hitches a ride in his coffin to his hometown in rural California, where arachnophobe Dr. Ross Jennings (Jeff Daniels) has just moved in with his wife, Molly (Harley Jane Kozak), and young son. As town residents start turning up dead, Jennings begins to suspect spiders, and must face his fears as he and no-nonsense exterminator Delbert McClintock (John Goodman) fight to stop a deadly infestation. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Pumpkinhead
bbcamerica.us.description: An old woman summons a grotesque figure to punish teenage dirt bikers for killing a man's (Lance Henriksen) son. - 1988

bbcamerica.us.title: Cujo
bbcamerica.us.description: Bitten by a rabid bat, a huge dog traps a Maine woman (Dee Wallace) and her young son (Danny Pintauro) in their Ford Pinto. - 1983

bbcamerica.us.title: An American Werewolf in London
bbcamerica.us.description: A New York student (David Naughton) becomes the scourge of London after being bitten by a beast on the moors. - 1981

bbcamerica.us.title: The Lost Boys
bbcamerica.us.description: A woman and her sons move to a coastal California town for a fresh start, unaware that it is full of teenage vampire punks. - 1987

bbcamerica.us.title: The Graham Norton Show ᴺᵉʷ
bbcamerica.us.description: Celebrity guests discuss their current projects and the latest gossip hitting newsstands. (Talk, Entertainment, Comedy, Interview) - 2026-10-16

bbcamerica.us.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
bbcamerica.us.description: On the run from a bank robbery that left several police officers dead, Seth Gecko (George Clooney) and his paranoid, loose-cannon brother, Richard (Quentin Tarantino), hightail it to the Mexican border. Kidnapping preacher Jacob Fuller (Harvey Keitel) and his kids, the criminals sneak across the border in the family's RV and hole up in a topless bar. Unfortunately, the bar also happens to be home base for a gang of vampires, and the brothers and their hostages have to fight their way out. (Horror, Action, Dark comedy, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1996

bbcamerica.us.title: The Return of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: When foreman Frank (James Karen) shows new employee Freddy (Thom Mathews) a secret military experiment in a supply warehouse, the two klutzes accidentally release a gas that reanimates corpses into flesh-eating zombies. As the epidemic spreads throughout Louisville, Ky., and the creatures satisfy their hunger in gory and outlandish ways, Frank and Freddy fight to survive with the help of their boss (Clu Gulager) and a mysterious mortician (Don Calfa). (Horror, Comedy) - 1985

bbcamerica.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Earth's Great Seasons - Autumn
bbcamerica.us.description: With winter fast approaching, life has to get ready and that means feeding up while you can, fighting for the last chance to breed and rushing to grow up before the cold returns. (Nature, Documentary) - 2017-06-23

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth: Dynasties II - Macaque
bbcamerica.us.description: High in the mountains of Morocco lives a descendant of a long line of macaque rulers who has been in charge of her troop for many winters - one of the longest recorded reigns of an alpha - but this year is likely to be her last. (Nature, Documentary) - 2025-12-07

bbcamerica.us.title: Cujo
bbcamerica.us.description: In this tale of a killer canine, man's best friend turns into his worst enemy. When sweet St. Bernard Cujo is bitten by a bat, he starts behaving oddly and becomes very aggressive. As Cujo morphs into a dangerous beast, he goes on a rampage in a small town. Stay-at-home mom Donna (Dee Wallace) gets caught in Cujo's crosshairs on a fateful errand with her son, Tad (Danny Pintauro). Stuck in their tiny car, Donna and Tad have a frightening showdown with the crazed animal. (Horror, Thriller) - 1983

bbcamerica.us.title: Once Bitten
bbcamerica.us.description: A centuries-old vampire, the countess (Lauren Hutton) has kept her youthful look by drinking the blood of male virgins. Since she finds this prey challenging to come by, she is thrilled when she meets young Mark Kendall (Jim Carrey), who wants to lose his virginity, yet has a reluctant girlfriend, Robin (Karen Kopins). After luring Mark away from a club, the countess drinks his blood, but the hapless guy isn't sure what has happened until he starts exhibiting unusual symptoms. (Comedy) - 1985

bbcamerica.us.title: The Lost Boys
bbcamerica.us.description: Teenage brothers Michael (Jason Patric) and Sam (Corey Haim) move with their mother (Dianne Wiest) to a small town in northern California. While the younger Sam meets a pair of kindred spirits in geeky comic-book nerds Edward (Corey Feldman) and Alan (Jamison Newlander), the angst-ridden Michael soon falls for Star (Jami Gertz) -- who turns out to be in thrall to David (Kiefer Sutherland), leader of a local gang of vampires. Sam and his new friends must save Michael and Star from the undead. (Horror, Comedy) - 1987

bbcamerica.us.description: When a triple murder case ends with the suspect's acquittal, McCoy and Kincaid investigate the judge assigned to the trial. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-11-01

bbcamerica.us.description: When Briscoe and Curtis capture a couple after a violent crime spree, the woman claims she was forced to commit the crimes against her will. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-11-08

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Paranoia
bbcamerica.us.description: Briscoe and his new partner investigate murder at a college; McCoy risks a lawyer's disbarment to win a case. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-11-16

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Humiliation
bbcamerica.us.description: Kincaid prosecutes a case alone when she is certain that a prominent plastic surgeon who is accused of murdering a prostitute is guilty. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-11-22

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Angel
bbcamerica.us.description: The detectives investigate a kidnapping case involving a woman's claim that her infant vanished from a church while she was in the confessional. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 1995-11-29

bbcamerica.us.title: Law & Order - Remand

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas Under the Northern Lights
greatamericancountry.us.description: A historian seeks inspiration for her next project in her family's hometown, which is famous for experiencing the Northern Lights. While there, she bonds with a local tour guide who shows her the town's Christmas traditions.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Call Me Mrs. Miracle
greatamericancountry.us.description: Mrs. "Miracle" Merkle (Doris Roberts) helps save a struggling department store during the Christmas season.

greatamericancountry.us.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
greatamericancountry.us.description: A city manager recruits the help of a childhood friend to save his town's Christmas charity event, while she attempts to set him up with her close friend.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas Keepsake
greatamericancountry.us.description: Following their move to a new city, a father bonds with his daughter and stumbles upon an unexpected romance while tracking down the original owner of a Christmas time capsule.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Fir Crazy
greatamericancountry.us.description: A reluctant Christmas-tree seller (Sarah Lancaster) finds renewed holiday spirit and new romance with a repeat customer (Eric Johnson), but a mean-spirited executive (Colin Mochrie) threatens to shut down her family's business.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas Star
greatamericancountry.us.description: An astronomer predicts that a new meteor shower will appear over a tiny town, but she must convince the locals to help with her discovery at the expense of a Christmas tradition.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Dash of Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: To apply for her dream job at a foodie startup, an executive must learn to bake. When she recruits a handsome baker to help her, she inadvertently ends up in a Christmas Bake-off.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Kindhearted Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: To capture the holiday spirit, Jaime anonymously gives gifts to those in need. Word spreads and people in town wonder who this "Secret Santa" is. She remains anonymous and meets Scott. Jamie tries to keep her secret and pursue a new romance.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Silver Bells at Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Determined to save her mother's Christmas shop, Ginny must choose between protecting the past she loves and embracing a future that could change her heart forever.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Wisconsin Christmas Pie
greatamericancountry.us.description: A pastry chef returns to Wisconsin when she learns her family's farm is on the brink of being sold to developers. Reconnecting with her high school sweetheart, they discover love may just be the recipe for saving the farm -- and their hearts.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
greatamericancountry.us.description: Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow, Muriel, the Christmas darling of Icicle Falls. She is now separated from her husband Rob and tries her best with her daughter.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Designing Christmas With You
greatamericancountry.us.description: With her career on the line, a decorator must work with an unexpected partner to showcase a house for an upcoming Christmas gala.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Joy for Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: A publicist introduces a famous athlete to the joys of Christmas in the hopes that he will assist her in saving her family's annual charity.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Royally Wrapped for Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Lindsay, the NY director of an international charity organization, is called to the Kingdom of Veronia by the royal family to interview for the job of overseeing the whole operation. During the interview process, she finds true love with the prince.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Destined 2: Christmas Once More
greatamericancountry.us.description: Theo continues to miss connecting with his girlfriend, Kim, as he attempts to propose at Christmas.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas of Giving
greatamericancountry.us.description: Belle Carter has devoted her whole life to making the holidays bright for those in need. With Christmas approaching and the community's hopes hanging in the balance, she discovers believing in the best of people is the greatest gift of all.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Jingle Bell Princess
greatamericancountry.us.description: After a series of mishaps, sophisticated Princess Amelia becomes stranded in the small town of Tucker Maine, where she becomes a guest of the unsuspecting Cutler family, widowed father Sam and daughter Sophie, but doesn't tell them she's a princess.

greatamericancountry.us.title: There's No Place Like Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Sparks fly between a big city realtor and a local photographer when she returns to her hometown of Evergreen Falls during the holidays.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Home Sweet Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Sparks fly between a successful attorney and her childhood friend after they both inherit her late great-uncle's sprawling patch of sugar maple forest.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas at the Drive-In
greatamericancountry.us.description: A property lawyer finds romance during the holidays while trying to save her town's local drive-in from closing down.

hallmark.us.title: Time for You to Come Home for Christmas
hallmark.us.description: Katherine returns home after her husband passes and meets a veteran who is on his holiday journey. As Christmas nears, they learn of a bond that may be the miracle they need. (Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2019-12-06

hallmark.us.title: Flipping for Christmas
hallmark.us.description: It's almost Christmas when busy realtor Abigail agrees to help her sister with the simple flip of a recently inherited home. Unfortunately, co-beneficiary Bo has other plans in mind. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy) - 2023-11-03

hallmark.us.title: Christmas Getaway
hallmark.us.description: After a surprising breakup with her boyfriend, a travel writer decides to go on the picturesque Christmas vacation planned for the two of them, alone. (Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2017-12-23

hallmark.us.title: A Christmas Detour
hallmark.us.description: Two travelers become linked when a snowstorm grounds their flight in Buffalo. Paige desperately needs to find a way to New York City to meet her fiancé's parents, and it's up to Dylan, a fellow passenger and a guy she can't stand, to get her there. (Comedy, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2015-11-28

hallmark.us.title: A Grand Ole Opry Christmas
hallmark.us.description: When Gentry returns to the iconic Grand Ole Opry, a magical twist of fate sends her back in time to discover love and hope. (Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2025-11-29

hallmark.us.title: A Dream of Christmas
hallmark.us.description: An ambitious married woman gets more than she bargained for when her wish to be single again is granted. She awakens to discover she's got everything she's ever wanted, except her husband. She resolves to find him a second time. (Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2016-12-04

hallmark.us.title: Christmas at the Plaza
hallmark.us.description: When historian Jessica is hired to create the Plaza's Christmas display, she finds more than facts while teaming up with handsome decorator Nick to bring the display to life. (Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2019-11-28

hallmark.us.title: Crown for Christmas
hallmark.us.description: After getting fired from her job as a maid at a ritzy New York City hotel, a woman accepts a temporary job as governess to a young girl who is part of a powerful European family. (Holiday, Movie, Romance, TV Movie) - 2015-11-27

hallmark.us.title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
hallmark.us.description: When organized caterer Lexi and chill snowboarder Ridge notice a spark between their single parents, they begrudgingly team up to set them up. (Holiday, Movie, Romance, Romantic comedy, TV Movie) - 2026-10-16

hallmark.us.title: Five More Minutes
hallmark.us.description: Inspired by Scotty McCreery's song "Five More Minutes," a woman's Christmas wish is answered in unexpected ways when her late grandfather's journal turns up and reveals an untold romance. (Comedy, Drama, Holiday, Movie, Romance) - 2021-11-20

hallmark.us.title: She's Making a List

retroplex.us.description: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Lawless Frontier
retroplex.us.description: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Border Feud
retroplex.us.description: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Texas Terror
retroplex.us.description: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Paradise Canyon
retroplex.us.description: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Badmen
retroplex.us.description: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. While both Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, the son wants to keep it for himself. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Hawk of Powder River
retroplex.us.description: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions. (Western) - 1948

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler

tastemade.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemade.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemade.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cooking for the Crew
tastemade.us.description: Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast for the crew - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce. (Cooking) - 2024-02-22

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
tastemade.us.description: Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Day With Hugo
tastemade.us.description: Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Bread Masters
tastemade.us.description: Irving Quiroz wrote the book on Mexican bread. Pati visits his workshop for his secret to making the perfect campechana, then meets Chuy Elizondo, owner of one of the hottest brunch spots in town. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips
tastemade.us.description: Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert! (Cooking) - 2026-07-13

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Not Your Nonna's Risotto
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits. (Cooking) - 2026-07-06

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads! (Cooking) - 2026-07-20

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels! (Cooking) - 2026-07-20

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Worth the Hype - Cubanos, Empanadas, & Smoked Beef Rib in Miami
tastemade.us.description: Frankie goes to Miami to sample serious cherry smoked beef rib, three cheese spinach empanadas, and a legendary Cubano sandwich with homemade mustard. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemade.us.title: Worth the Hype - Pho, Poke, & Pig in O'ahu
tastemade.us.description: Frankie explores Hawaii's O'ahu island to get nourished from fresh tuna poke, heartfelt Pho, and hand-pounded poi. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemade.us.title: Worth the Hype - Quail, Alligator Sausage, & Gumbo in New Orleans
tastemade.us.description: Frankie stops by New Orleans to chow down on lacquered quail, a beast of a Po Boy, and Creole Beef Daube. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemade.us.title: Worth the Hype - Picasso Pasta, Custard Cups & Cowboy Steaks in New Jersey
tastemade.us.description: Grab your fork and join Frankie Celenza as he eats his way through New Jersey's most iconic spots that are worth the hype. From silky custard cups to pasta Picasso to giant pizza slices, just add PEPSI and you've got the perfect pairing. (Cooking, Entertainment)

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Grubby Good Food
tastemade.us.description: Send your taste buds on a first class food tour without even leaving the Struggle kitchen! Frankie whips up his favorite regional specialties from five destinations, making them as authentic as possible while sticking to his budget. (Cooking) - 2023-11-10

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Turn Up For Tomatoes
tastemade.us.description: Tomatoes are one of the most produced fruits, especially when in season. Frankie teaches us how to prepare them fresh in a variety of ways. And for even more savings, Frankie will share a few tips on how to preserve tomatoes. (Cooking) - 2019-07-26

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Mushroom Mania
tastemade.us.description: Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They're packed with nutritional value, and they're an affordable plant-based meat replacement. We'll learn about all things mushrooms and how to make some inventive, flavorful dishes. (Cooking) - 2020-03-06

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Frankie & Flour
tastemade.us.description: Flour has the superpower to transform into an endless variety of meals, and a little goes a long way. Frankie teaches us how to make three different meals using flour as the affordable vehicle. Save money, learn new techniques. (Cooking) - 2019-08-16

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders - Sweet Potato Chilli and Homemade Nachos
tastemade.us.description: Jamie shows us a delicious range of one-pan dishes: a super-speedy smashed lemongrass chicken; flavour-packed sweet potato chilli with homemade nachos; and a chocolate party tray cake with retro tinned-mandarin and buttercream filling. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders - Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders - Weeknight Roast Lamb and Eggplant
tastemade.us.description: Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders - Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Famous Pastes of Spices
tastemade.us.description: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán Meats
tastemade.us.description: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Los Mariachis
tastemade.us.description: Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake. (Cooking) - 2024-03-07

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Flour Power
tastemade.us.description: Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito. (Cooking) - 2024-02-08

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Carne Asada with La Familia
tastemade.us.description: Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together. (Cooking) - 2024-02-01

tastemade.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tacos and a Tostada
tastemade.us.description: Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple - Gochujang Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a speedy midweek chicken tray bake. He shows us cool ways to upgrade salmon, knocks up a shelf-raid quesadilla toastie, and transforms a batch-cook Bolognese into cheesy bread bowls. All finished off with a super simple banoffee tart. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple - Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart. (Cooking)

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Metamorphosis
tntwest.us.description: The team looks into the death of a teenage circus aerialist; Rush faces possible charges in another case.

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - Two Weddings
tntwest.us.description: While at a colleague's wedding, the team tries to determine if the bride was responsible for her former fiancé's death.

tntwest.us.title: Cold Case - One Fall
tntwest.us.description: The team reopens the case of a dockworker who moonlighted as a professional wrestler until he was fatally shot in 1986; Valens secretly looks into a lead on the man who mugged and raped his mother.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Fidelity ᴺᵉʷ
tntwest.us.description: When an FBI evidence locker is robbed, leaving behind a dead ERT agent, the team discovers a vigilante duo looking to take down a high-scale pedophile ring; Isobel meets the new Assistant Director in Charge.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Roleplay ᴺᵉʷ
tntwest.us.description: When a big city donor is murdered inside her apartment, the team tracks down the young killer who leads them into a crypto scam he's been running with one of his victims, looking to seek revenge on his family.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Long Shot ᴺᵉʷ
tntwest.us.description: Following the assassination of a major corporate executive, the team races to find leaders of a dormant terrorist organization that has re-emerged; OA is temporarily reassigned after refusing to follow orders but is paired up with a familiar face.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Defector ᴺᵉʷ
tntwest.us.description: The theft of a bioweapon from an unwitting defector forces the team to work with an old foe to secure the lethal pathogen and prevent an outbreak.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Pilot
tntwest.us.description: After a bomb explosion devastates a residential apartment building, special agents Maggie Bell and Omar Adom "OA" Zidan of the New York office of the FBI investigate a possible war between rival gangs.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Green Birds
tntwest.us.description: After eight people are fatally poisoned at a deli in New York City, agents Maggie Bell and OA Zidan trace the crime to an unlikely culprit and conduct a sting operation to prevent further attacks.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Prey
tntwest.us.description: Special agents Maggie Bell and OA Zidan join the team to investigate the murders of 18 young women, and they get help from a survivor associated with the deceased.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Crossfire
tntwest.us.description: As the body count continues to rise, Maggie Bell and OA Zidan rush to track down an active sniper who has an elusive motive.

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Doomsday
tntwest.us.description: Maggie and OA investigate the death of a safety inspector and its possible connection to a leak at a nuclear power plant.

tntwest.us.title: Godzilla vs. Kong
tntwest.us.description: Fearsome monsters Godzilla and Kong square off in an epic battle for the ages. The initial confrontation between the two titans -- instigated by unseen forces -- is only the beginning of the mystery that lies deep within the core of the planet. - 2021

tntwest.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
tntwest.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. - 2023

tntwest.us.title: Twister
tntwest.us.description: During the approach of the most powerful storm in decades, university professor Dr. Jo Harding (Helen Hunt) and an underfunded team of students prepares the prototype for Dorothy, a ground-breaking tornado data-gathering device conceived by her estranged husband, Bill (Bill Paxton). When Harding tells Bill that Dorothy is ready for testing -- and that their privately funded rival Dr. Jonas Miller (Cary Elwes) has stolen the idea and built his own -- Bill rejoins the team for one last mission. (Action, Adventure) - 1996

tntwest.us.title: The Martian
tntwest.us.description: When astronauts blast off from the planet Mars, they leave behind Mark Watney, presumed dead after a fierce storm. With only a meager amount of supplies, the stranded visitor must utilize his wits and spirit to find a way to survive on the hostile planet. Meanwhile, back on Earth, members of NASA and a team of international scientists work tirelessly to bring him home, while his crew mates hatch their own plan for a daring rescue mission. (Science fiction, Adventure, Drama) - 2015

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Fortunate Son
tntwest.us.description: A teen shows up at FBI headquarters with a large bag of fentanyl, seeking the team's protection from the men who shot his father; Nina goes to Scola with a proposal he is hesitant to accept. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2022-12-13

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Second Life
tntwest.us.description: The abduction of a young woman leads the team back to a cold case from 18 years ago, which pushes Isobel to reconnect with her old partner Jake and take another shot at solving one of her first cases at the bureau. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2023-01-03

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Heroes
tntwest.us.description: The team jumps into action when analyst Kelly Moran is taken hostage. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2023-01-10

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Breakdown
tntwest.us.description: After a mysterious bioweapon leaves two MTA workers dead and one injured, the team rushes to determine who is behind the attack and the location of their next target; Jubal's past demons begin to surface. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2023-01-24

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Protégé
tntwest.us.description: The team investigates the murder of a professional informant after he's found dead outside an abandoned factory; Maggie reconnects with an old colleague and mentor. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2023-02-14

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Family Man
tntwest.us.description: After a senator's daughter is kidnapped and held for ransom, the FBI must find the little girl before their time limit expires; they must dig into the senator's past for clues to who did this to his family. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2018-10-30

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Cops and Robbers
tntwest.us.description: Maggie and OA hunt down a ruthless group of robbers who are posing as police officers to target armored trucks. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2018-11-13

tntwest.us.title: FBI - This Land Is Your Land
tntwest.us.description: Maggie and OA lead the search for an abducted former biological weapons chemist. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2018-11-20

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Compromised
tntwest.us.description: After a key witness and a U.S. marshal are ambushed and killed, Maggie and OA must find the man who leaked the information that led to their murders. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2018-12-04

tntwest.us.title: FBI - The Armorer's Faith
tntwest.us.description: When an illegal arms broker-turned-informant is assassinated, OA assumes his identity and goes undercover to stop the sale of dangerous weapons, with help from Maggie and their former FBI instructor. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2018-12-11

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Identity Crisis
tntwest.us.description: When a judge and her daughter are murdered after she sentences a man to life in prison, Maggie and OA search for the killer; Dana has a history with the victim and a vested interest in the case. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2019-01-15

tntwest.us.title: FBI - A New Dawn
tntwest.us.description: When an alt-right provocateur is murdered after giving a speech at a university in New York City, Maggie and OA investigate the school's more extreme political groups and rely on OA's sister, a student, for help. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2019-01-22

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Partners in Crime
tntwest.us.description: Maggie and OA must find a couple that is responsible for a spree of violent armed robberies that led to the death of an off-duty police officer. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2019-02-12

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Exposed
tntwest.us.description: After an investigative journalist is murdered, the team uncovers information linking the suspect to past cases; the victim's death strikes a chord with Maggie, leaving her desperate for answers in regard to a traumatic event in her personal life. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2019-02-19

tntwest.us.title: The Shawshank Redemption
tntwest.us.description: Andy Dufresne (Tim Robbins) is sentenced to two consecutive life terms in prison for the murders of his wife and her lover and is sentenced to a tough prison. However, only Andy knows he didn't commit the crimes. While there, he forms a friendship with Red (Morgan Freeman), experiences brutality of prison life, adapts, helps the warden, etc., all in 19 years. (Drama) - 1994
