365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - Hurricane Linda
365blk.us.description: Things get tense when Jerri's (Suzanne Douglas) best friend (guest star Jennifer Lewis) blows into town and meddles in everything.

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - Here Comes Z Bride
365blk.us.description: Robert and Jerri love Zaria's perfect boyfriend until he asks for the 17-year-old's hand in marriage.

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - Hood Sweet 'Hood
365blk.us.description: T.K. (Tyrone Burton) ponders the use of a gun to settle the score with street thugs who harass and steal.

365blk.us.title: Roc - Joey the Bartender
365blk.us.description: Joey (Rocky Carroll) becomes a bartender to pay off his bar tab and Andrew (Carl Gordon) baby-sits Sheila (Alexis Fields).

365blk.us.title: Roc - Crime & Punishment
365blk.us.description: Roc and Joey (Charles Dutton, Rocky Carroll) disagree on Sheila's (Alexis Fields) punishment for breaking her curfew.

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's Daddy's Little Girls
365blk.us.description: An unexpected romance blooms between a struggling mechanic and the attorney who is representing him in a custody battle for his young daughters. - 2007

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: The plaintiff had a short-term relationship with the defendant and rented a room in his home, but says he failed to return her security deposit when she moved out.

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: The plaintiff says her father was killed before she was born, and years later she discovered through social media that the defendant may be her sister, so she has petitioned the court for a sibling DNA test.

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: A woman hires a family friend to care for her visually impaired mother, then discovers she is staying out all night; the defendant countersues, saying the plaintiff and her daughter threatened her.

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: A man sues his ex-fiancee for repayment of a loan and a television; the defendant says her ex was verbally abusive and insists he forgave the debt.

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - Perversions of Justice
365blk.us.description: Gillespie tries to calm public furor while investigating charges a science teacher molested a student.

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - ... And Justice for Some
365blk.us.description: Gillespie and Virgil have different game plans concerning the fate of a federal criminal who is linked to a local hit-and-run case.

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - Hearts of Gold
365blk.us.description: Bubba's romance with a high school sweetheart conflicts with the murder investigation of an attorney.

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - Quick Fix
365blk.us.description: Evidence indicates a mentally impaired girl is the mother of an infant found in a shallow grave.

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's The Single Moms Club
365blk.us.description: Brought together by their children's potential expulsion from school, diverse single mothers (Nia Long, Amy Smart, Cocoa Brown) form a support group to help one another overcome life's challenges. - 2014

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's A Madea Family Funeral
365blk.us.description: A reunion turns into an unexpected nightmare when Madea, Joe and other family members gather for an anniversary. Instead of fun and relaxation, the gang soon find themselves attending an elaborate funeral that doesn't quite go according to plan. - 2019

365blk.us.title: Purple Rain
365blk.us.description: A victim of his own anger, the Kid (Prince) is a Minneapolis musician on the rise with his band, the Revolution, escaping a tumultuous home life through music. While trying to avoid making the same mistakes as his truculent father (Clarence Williams III), the Kid navigates the club scene and a rocky relationship with a captivating singer, Apollonia (Apollonia Kotero). But another musician, Morris (Morris Day), looks to steal the Kid's spotlight -- and his girl. (Musical, Drama, Romance, Music) - 1984

365blk.us.title: Force of Execution
365blk.us.description: A crime boss (Steven Seagal) needs the help of his former protégé (Bren Foster) to deal with a threat (Ving Rhames) to his empire. (Action, Crime drama) - 2013

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: A man says that, when the defendant was 8 months old, her mother told him that he was not her biological father, but he believes he is, so he petitioned the court for a paternity test. (Reality, Law) - 2018-05-02

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - Front Window
365blk.us.description: When Robert's brother Kelly visits, he spots a neighbor furtively remove what looks like a corpse from his house. (Sitcom) - 1999-06-06

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - Talkin' Trash
365blk.us.description: Robert (Robert Townsend) intervenes when Zaria (Reagan Gomez-Preston) is replaced as a radio talk show host by T.K. (Tyrone Dorzell Burton). (Sitcom) - 1999-06-13

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - To Kiss or Not to Kiss
365blk.us.description: Zaria and T.K. must share a passionate kiss in the senior play; Nicholas adopts a bad-boy attitude in hope of attracting a classmate. (Sitcom) - 1999-07-11

365blk.us.title: Roc - Labor Intensive
365blk.us.description: Roc reluctantly agrees to attend a class for prospective parents with Eleanor; Joey attempts to outsmart a well-known con artist. (Sitcom) - 1993-10-05

365blk.us.title: Roc - Unforgiven
365blk.us.description: Roc and Joey (Charles S. Dutton, Rocky Carroll) face personal dilemmas after they make promises they may not be able to keep. (Sitcom) - 1993-10-12

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's A Madea Family Funeral
365blk.us.description: A joyous reunion in small-town Georgia turns into an unexpected nightmare when Madea, Joe, Aunt Bam and other family members gather for an anniversary party that turns out to be a sham. Instead of fun and relaxation, Madea and the gang soon find themselves attending an elaborate funeral that doesn't quite go according to plan. (Comedy) - 2019

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: A woman sues her daughter for the cost of repairing damages to their apartment and says her daughter went to jail for witness tampering. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-23

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: After meeting him online, the plaintiff dated the defendant and thought he was an honest, hardworking man, but soon discovered he has a criminal history; the defendant says the plaintiff became obsessed with him. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-24

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: The plaintiff says her grandson is totally out of control, and he stole her car and totaled it. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-25

365blk.us.title: Judge Mathis
365blk.us.description: A woman sues her much-younger ex-boyfriend for repayment of a loan; he says they were only friends with benefits, and he offered to make payments to her, but she refused to accept them. (Reality, Law) - 2019-10-28

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - Homecoming
365blk.us.description: Willing suspects hamper the investigation after a paroled convict is murdered; Gillespie is held responsible for the convict's earlier release. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1990-11-13

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - A Problem Too Personal
365blk.us.description: Gillespie appears to be apathetic about prosecuting Harriet DeLong's ex-husband, who has been arrested on a murder and robbery charge. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1990-11-20

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - A Final Arrangement
365blk.us.description: All signs point to bookstore owner Carl Tibbitts as a suspect in his wife's murder, but Sweet believes in his friend's innocence. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1990-11-27

365blk.us.title: In the Heat of the Night - Family Matters
365blk.us.description: Virgil's cousin is the prime suspect in a robbery-murder, complicating Virgil's attempts to reconcile his aunt with the family. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1990-12-04

365blk.us.title: The Great Debaters
365blk.us.description: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions. (Docudrama, Drama) - 2007

bbcearth.us.title: Great Barrier Reef - Reef to Rainforest
bbcearth.us.description: Only seven percent of the Great Barrier Reef is coral, and the remainder is a variety of interconnected habitats including the world's oldest jungle, hundreds of islands, mangrove swamps, deep water gardens, sand flats and seagrass. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Travel) - 20120108

bbcearth.us.title: Great Barrier Reef - Reef and Beyond
bbcearth.us.description: Creatures travel thousands of miles to visit the reef and Pacific weather patterns are likely to further shape the terrain and wildlife. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Travel) - 20120115

bbcearth.us.title: Hidden Kingdoms - Under Open Skies

bbcearth.us.title: Hidden Kingdoms - Secret Forests
bbcearth.us.description: A tree shrew and a tarsier display quick wits and cunning as they search for food; a chipmunk races against time to collect enough nuts to last the winter. (Episode, Miniseries, Nature, Documentary) - 20140123

bbcearth.us.title: Hidden Kingdoms - Urban Jungles

bbcearth.us.title: How Nature Works - The Emerald Band
bbcearth.us.description: Beginning with the amazing diversity of species in the rainforest; discover the improbable connections, bizarre behavioural strategies and intricate mechanisms that make life on Earth possible. (Episode, Series, Nature, Documentary) - 20130515

bbcearth.us.title: How Nature Works - The Secret of Savannah
bbcearth.us.description: Elephants are crucial to keeping the East African grasslands in shape. (Episode, Series, Nature, Documentary) - 20130522

bbcearth.us.title: How Nature Works - The Magic Forest
bbcearth.us.description: A lynx depends on a caterpillar to survive, and the forest depends on salmon. (Episode, Series, Nature, Documentary) - 20130529

bbcearth.us.title: How Nature Works - Waterworlds
bbcearth.us.description: The journey that water takes from streams, to swamps and to the ocean. (Episode, Series, Nature, Documentary) - 20130828

bbcearth.us.title: Elephant Family and Me

bbcearth.us.title: Elephant Family and Me

bbcearth.us.title: Expedition Tiger

bbcearth.us.title: Forces of Nature - Shape
bbcearth.us.description: Understanding shapes in nature and the rules that bind the universe. (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary) - 20160914

bbcearth.us.title: Forces of Nature - Motion
bbcearth.us.description: The consequences of natural forces that keep Earth on the move, from tidal bores to hurricanes. (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary) - 20161005

bbcearth.us.title: Forces of Nature - Elements

bbcearth.us.title: Forces of Nature - Color
bbcearth.us.description: The creation of Earth's colors and what they mean. (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary) - 20160928

bbcearth.us.title: Frozen Planet - On Thin Ice, Part 1
bbcearth.us.description: Rising temperatures transform the Poles and the implications are far-reaching for their animal and human inhabitants. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature) - 20261023

bbcearth.us.title: Galapagos - Born of Fire
bbcearth.us.description: A look at the archeological history of these volcanic islands and how numerous unusual species originated there. (Episode, Miniseries, Documentary, Nature) - 20070604

bbcearth.us.title: Galapagos - Islands That Changed the World
bbcearth.us.description: Many of Charles Darwin's theories on evolution were based on his observations in the Galápagos. (Episode, Miniseries, Documentary, Nature) - 20070611

bbcearth.us.title: Galapagos - Forces of Change
bbcearth.us.description: A glimpse into what the future holds for the Galápagos as man and ocean currents have brought change to the islands. (Episode, Miniseries, Documentary, Nature) - 20070723

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mexico City to Oaxaca Rick Stein visits the Mexican capital to sample the Aztec cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Oaxaca to Chinantlan Mountains Rick Stein's latest travels take him to Mexico's culinary capital Oaxaca.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Oaxaca to Yucatan Peninsula Rick Stein heads east from Oaxaca to the Yucatán Peninsula, a place once frequented by real pirates of the Caribbean, including Sir Francis Drake.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Nisha Katona cooks salmon and tomato curry, and eggplant curry with fresh roti.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nisha cooks oxtail and shin curry, spiced barbecued prawns and banana pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Nisha cooks some Malaysian mussels and ginger biscuit lamb raan.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Nisha cooks meatball curry and tandoori chops with turmeric chips.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Nisha cooks egg and cauliflower curry and some Hungarian plum dumplings.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E09 Nisha cooks Bengali fish in banana leaves and a big roasted rib of beef.

bbcfood.us.title: Nisha Katona's Home Kitchen
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E10 Nisha cooks chicken and apricot biryani and fish finger sandwiches.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Suffolk and Naples Rick celebrates the abundance of seafood and the rich, colorful sauces of Naples.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 India and Cornwall Rick catches turbot off the Cornish coast and cooks it with cider and cream.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spain and Britain Rick's off to Galicia in Spain to sample some rare shellfish.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 India and America A spicy shark vindaloo and the making of an authentic dhal with lentils.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Australia and Italy Seafood king Rick travels to Queensland, Australia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 America and Cornwall Chesapeake Bay in the U.S., cooking traditional oyster dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Thailand and Cornwall Rick goes to Hua Hin in Thailand, where he spends time in local markets talking to locals about various types of food; in Cornwall, he fries fish and jazzes it up with red curry and steamed jasmine rice.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 America and Yorkshire Rick visits America, Naples and the UK in Whitby, with good old English fish and chips in the final episode.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Sweet and Sour Nigel Slater shows us how to prepare five different sweet and sour dishes.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish and Meat Nigel continues to explore successful food marriages in the kitchen.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Spicy and Cool Nigel Slater shows us how to mix spicy flavors with something cooling.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Soft and Crisp Nigel Slater continues his exploration of brilliant culinary combinations.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Sugar and Spice Nigel shows a classic cinnamon, ginger and plum cake and demonstrates the unexpected such as sticky ribs and a spicy lentil stew with caramelized onions.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Cooking
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Born and Bred Nigel transforms everyday suppers, including a dish of baked mushrooms and chestnuts and a home-grown pud of blackberry and fig pie.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Kolkata and Chennai Rick explores Bengal and Tamil Nadu, the regions that began Britain's love affair with curry; Rick enjoys the prominence of fish and seafood in their dishes, flavored with mustard in Kolkata and tamarind in Chennai.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Mumbai and Pondicherry Rick explores Mumbai in search of the bombil, the fish that immortalized Bombay Duck; enjoying Parsee hospitality.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Lucknow and Punjab Rick Stein arrives in the cultural city of Lucknow, India; it is reputed to be the curry capital of India.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh Rick Stein visits the royal state of Rajasthan, a land of kings, hilltop forts and palaces, where the local population are serious meat-eaters.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's India
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Madurai and Lucknow Rick Stein discovers a five-star hotel in Madurai employing local housewives for genuine home-cooked dishes and enjoys Chettinad Chicken, a dish inspired by spices brought back from both the east and the west by traveling merchants.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Nigella introduces her love of Italian food through a spectacular yet simple Sicilian pasta with tomatoes, garlic and almonds and a mid-week family feast of tagliata.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Nigella Lawson shares the secrets of her Italian roast chicken, served alongside a saffron orzotto; Nigella prepares coffee ice cream for dessert, inspired by the ice cream parlors of Florence; a chocolate olive oil cake provides an extra treat.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Episode 3 Pork loin stuffed with Parma ham and oregano, served alongside her speedy mock mash and lazy person's vignarola.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Liquorice pudding; Sardinian sun-dried and toasted couscous; butterflied leg of lamb; baby aubergines with oregano and roasted red onion.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Nigella starts with her take on a light and sunny yogurt pot cake; she recruits her niece and nephew to make a shortcut sausage meatball supper; Nigella prepares squid and prawns with marjoram and chili; a tiramisu ends the evening.

bbcfood.us.title: Nigellissima
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Episode 6 Lamb chops with mint; chilli and golden potatoes; ruby red plum and amoretti crumble; farro risotto with mushrooms.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein searches for herring along the northeast coast of Scotland.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Pilchards, bream, ormer and cockles with laverbread.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Sweet brown shrimp; flounder; fresh salmon; oysters; scallops.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Silver eels; edible seaweed; langoustines; pollan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Cockles and samphire; pink shrimps; Cromer crabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Wild smoked salmon; sea trout; sea moss pudding.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Lover's Guide
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Fresh cod; smoked kippers; prepares halibut with cucumber; salmon en croute.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Far Eastern Odyssey

combatwarchannel.us.title: Helicopter Warfare
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Vietnam Firefight During a rescue mission a desperate pilot cuts his own landing zone in forty foot tall bamboo.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Atomic Test at the Bikini Why so many cameras and equipment to film two atomic explosions just after the end of the Second World War?; what's the relationship between atomic testing and the famous bathing suit?

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E12 Theater Commanders Outstanding leaders; General Dwight D. Eisenhower and General Douglas MacArthur.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Bonhoeffer: Agent of Grace
combatwarchannel.us.description: Dietrich Bonhoeffer (Ulrich Tukur), a young Christian theologian, is hanged in a Nazi concentration camp for helping Jews escape from Germany.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Grey Wolves: Part 2 -- Nowhere To Hide
combatwarchannel.us.description: The history of several U-boats and their crew members.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Arnhem: A Bridge Too Far
combatwarchannel.us.description: The British 1st Airborne Division never sees combat again after losing 8,000 men in World War II's audacious and controversial Operation Market Garden of 1944.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Patton's Finest Hour: The Battle of the Bulge
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Battle of St. Vith The events that led to Hitler's Ardennes offensive.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Life of Adolf Hitler
combatwarchannel.us.description: Death & Decay The story of Adolf Hitler from his days of victory through to the last Götterdämmerung.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Attackers
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E08 At an airfield, Ivan meets Lyudmila, a pilot concealing an ailment; she mentors him as Lenya pushes Martynov; when scouts go missing, aerial battles ensue, forging deep bonds, and unveiling secrets.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Soviet Storm
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E07 The Liberation Of Ukraine The liberation of Ukraine from the Nazis.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII in Color: US Army Air Forces
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Out of the Shadows The outbreak of war prompts the U.S. to prepare for battle; as the Air Force adapts to Germany's tactics, Japan's surprise attack ignites a global conflict, pushing U.S. air power into both theaters.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E05 Big Picture: The Republic of Korea (ROK) Soldier Through the Korean Military Advisory Group, the South Korean Army has been able to build itself up to the fourth-strongest army in the world.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The True Glory
combatwarchannel.us.description: An account of the events in Europe from the June 1944 D-Day invasion through the surrender of Nazi Germany in May 1945.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Architects of Darkness
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Heinrich Himmler Heinrich Himmler, perhaps the strangest high-ranking individual of the Third Reich, was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Hitler's Eastern Front
combatwarchannel.us.description: Army Group North As Europe staggered toward war, Stalin saw opportunity to gain territory for Russia and stand apart from imperialist conflict between Britain, France and Germany.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Thunder Run on Baghdad
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Part Two Americans prepare for a decisive battle at Baghdad airport against Qusay Hussein's Republican Guard; Dr. Hana Hammed seeks husband's release.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: True, untold combat stories of everyday citizen soldiers fighting on the front lines of Europe during WWII.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E15 Resistance is Never Futile (April - June 1943) Tracking the main events of WWII with the help of archive footage; learning about Pearl Harbor, The Battle of Britain, D-Day, the dropping of the atomic bomb, and more; from the early battles right through to the complexities of the endgame.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War 2 - The Call of Duty: A Complete Timeline
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E16 Tentative Steps (July - September 1943) Tracking the main events of WWII with the help of archive footage; learning about Pearl Harbor, The Battle of Britain, D-Day, the dropping of the atomic bomb, and more; from the early battles right through to the complexities of the endgame.

combatwarchannel.us.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E17 The Assault on Toulon Allied troops invade southern France near Toulon in a combined amphibious and airborne assault; a coastal village is occupied after a raging battle between coastal batteries and naval guns; French underground members welcome the Allies.

combatwarchannel.us.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
combatwarchannel.us.description: An unprecedented look at the events leading up to the Normandy Invasion of D-Day; the cameramen took to the battlefield to capture and document that genuine experience of war.

combatwarchannel.us.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E15 Keeping the Railways Open French civilians and US Army engineers repair and salvage railroad yards, bridges and trains.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E10 Scorched Earth With the fall of Nazi Germany, the focus shifts to the Pacific, where Japan continues to resist; covering the island campaigns, kamikaze attacks, and the increasingly destructive U.S. bombing campaigns.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E10 United Nations Forces Escape the Chinese Trap The Army's 7th Division at the Manchurian border.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Soviet Storm
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 The Siege of Leningrad The horrific story of one of the longest sieges in military history, told from the Russian perspective; more than a million citizens lost their lives.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Blitzed: Nazis on Drugs
combatwarchannel.us.description: Examining the effects of the stimulant Pervitin, created in Nazi Germany in 1938, might have had on Adolf Hitler, his army and World War II.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World of Warships Clash of Titans
combatwarchannel.us.description: S02 E02 Sink the Bismarck In May 1941, the British Royal Navy relentlessly pursues the formidable battleship Bismarck with the mission to sink it at any cost.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Annihilation - The Destruction of Europe's Jews
combatwarchannel.us.description: Autopsy of a Mass Murder (The Trials) The trial of senior officials of the Third Reich begins before an international military tribunal in Nuremberg; 12 Nazis were sentenced to death and seven to prison terms.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E06 Big Picture: The Army Medical Corps A look at how the wounded were treated in battle, focusing on the care one man receives from medics along the line.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Annihilation - The Destruction of Europe's Jews
combatwarchannel.us.description: Lest We Forget While the hunt to find surviving Nazis continues, efforts are being made to preserve the memory of their victims.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Annihilation - The Destruction of Europe's Jews
combatwarchannel.us.description: The End of Illusions Adolf Hitler becomes chancellor in 1933 as Germany faces an economic crisis; he uses a cult of personality and propaganda from Joseph Goebbels to spread Nazi ideology.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Kuwait The president of Iraq launches his troops into Kuwait.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E04 Rugged Company K One of the most decorated companies in the Army; Company K is ordered to lay siege to a German infantry battalion.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII in Color: US Army Air Forces
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 Partners, Plans and Provisions Across the Pacific, Europe, Africa and Asia, U.S. air services partner with ground and naval forces; balancing transport, supply and combat, they protect Allied interests on land and sea.

combatwarchannel.us.title: World War II: The Real Mighty Eighth
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Forged in Fire The origins of the Mighty Eighth, birth and growth as it rises from the furnace of global conflict; as the world is plunged into war, the 8th Air Force carries out its first missions against the Axis powers.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Nazi Concentration Camps
combatwarchannel.us.description: This film is the official documentary report compiled from over 80,000 feet of film shot by Allied military photographers in the German concentration camps immediately after liberation.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Visions of War: Infantry Weapons and Tactics
combatwarchannel.us.description: Famous Third Army A record of the 281 days of the 3rd army offensive through France, Belgium and Germany, with air support from the 19th tactical air command.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Inside Hitler's Killing Machine
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E03 Hitler's Evil Scientists The Nazi think tank "Ahnenerbe" carried out countless acts of barbarism; stored on hundreds of microfilms which are only now available, the reports from this institution reveal the gruesome secrets of science according to Hitler.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Blood Money: Inside the Nazi Economy
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E02 An Economy of Death The Nazis needed to redistribute funds to finance their war; they rationed food, impacting occupied lands and revealing a genocidal obsession in their actions.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Modern Warfare: The Vietnam War
combatwarchannel.us.description: Fought for the defense of democracy, the Vietnam War was a 10-year-long vicious battle.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Nuclear Test Films
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E14 The Atom Strikes The first experimental blast set off in New Mexico and devastation of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

combatwarchannel.us.title: The Crimean War
combatwarchannel.us.description: Reasons The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

combatwarchannel.us.title: Great Tank Battles
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E01 Dawn of the Titans The development, both technologically and strategically from the Fuller 1919 philosophy through the German attack on Poland.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - A Cold December Morning
dateline.us.description: A mom's death tests a family's loyalty.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Plot Twist
dateline.us.description: Rachel Buffett, whose former fiancé, Daniel Wozniak, was convicted of two grisly murders, talks about being at the center of the investigation.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - A Shot in the Dark
dateline.us.description: When Cara Ryan shoots her ex-husband and accuses him of threatening to kill her, police question her motive.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Phony Rockefeller
dateline.us.description: The life of the charming con man who went by the name Clark Rockefeller.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Mystery at Payson Canyon
dateline.us.description: The murder of a brilliant professor.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The House
dateline.us.description: A daughter finds her father, a former FBI agent, murdered at his house; police dig into the man's past and begin to think the key to the mystery might be quite close to home.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Eastlake Conspiracy
dateline.us.description: When an Ohio resident is offered $50,000 to kill someone hundreds of miles away, investigators set up an elaborate sting operation to bring down those behind the murder-for-hire plot.

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Homeboy
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A low-life boxer (Mickey Rourke) hits town for a fight and meets a two-bit hood (Christopher Walken) who tries to lure him into a robbery. - 1988

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Direct Contact
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman. - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Prom Night
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: An ax killer stalks teens at the prom, apparently seeking revenge for a child's death six years earlier. - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after a successful assassination, a former mercenary finds himself the target of hit squads.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Baby Gone
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Emily, who is pregnant, quickly becomes friends with her new, pregnant neighbor. Little does Emily know that Kelly has been faking her pregnancy so she can steal her baby. - 2017

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Straight A's
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: At the behest of his mother's ghost, an addict (Ryan Phillippe) returns to his Louisiana home, where he must confront an ex-lover (Anna Paquin) who is now married to his brother. - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: An ex-Marine (James Marsden) faces a dilemma after he returns to South Philadelphia and discovers his brother (Brad Renfro) and cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) are entangled in the mob. - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A man (John Cusack) and his young son (Jamie Anderson) encounter an assassin (Morgan Freeman) while hiking in a forest. - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gerry
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After stopping their car for a hike, two men (Casey Affleck, Matt Damon) get lost in the desert without food or water. - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Animal Factory
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Sentenced to the state penitentiary for dealing drugs, a middle-class young man (Edward Furlong) seeks protection from a savvy inmate (Willem Dafoe). - 2000

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Killing Season
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A U.S. veteran (Robert De Niro) and a former Serbian soldier (John Travolta) play cat-and-mouse games in the remote wilderness. (Thriller, Action) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blind Horizon
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 2004

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Going All the Way
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war. (Drama) - 1997

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Code
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob. (Crime drama) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Bone Snatcher
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A scientist (Scott Bairstow) finds a monster that devours its prey in the deserts of South Africa. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Cold Blood
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways. (Action, Thriller) - 2019

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Hit & Run
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down. (Comedy, Action, Adventure) - 2012

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Are You Here
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After his eccentric pal (Zach Galifianakis) inherits a fortune from his estranged father, an aimless, womanizing weatherman (Owen Wilson) becomes involved in the legal battle initiated by his friend's sister (Amy Poehler). (Comedy drama) - 2013

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Blitz
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Kill Switch
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A military experiment to harness unlimited energy goes horribly awry, leaving a pilot with no choice but to fight through an imploding world to save his family and the planet itself. (Family, Science fiction, Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2017

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Behind the Monsters

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Behind the Monsters
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 Freddy Krueger Perhaps the most recognizable horror icon, Freddy Krueger's one-liners and merchandise has proven to be enjoyed by horror and non-horror fans alike.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Behind the Monsters

powernation.us.title: Engine Power - Supercharged 427 LSX

powernation.us.title: Engine Power - High Tech Slant Six
powernation.us.description: We reinforce our Slant Six with a fully-forged rotating assembly.

powernation.us.title: Engine Power - High Tech Slant Six Gets Boosted
powernation.us.description: We give our Slant Six a huge induction upgrade, a custom EFI system, and a turbocharger.

powernation.us.title: Detroit Muscle - What Muscle Car Is Right For You?

powernation.us.title: Dirt & Trails - Welcome to Dirt and Trails

powernation.us.title: Dirt & Trails - Project Leadfoot Gets a New Heart
powernation.us.description: Chris and Eric install a 600hp Ford 460 Big Block and Tremec TR4050 into Project Leadfoot.

powernation.us.title: Dirt & Trails - Gauges, Wiring, and Welding Galore!
powernation.us.description: Eric and Chris overhaul Project Leadfoot's gauges, build transfer case bracing, and wire it up.

powernation.us.title: Dirt & Trails - Exhausting Exhaust Systems
powernation.us.description: Eric measures Leadfoot's driveshafts; Chris preps the 600hp F-150 with new intake, exhaust and fuel.

powernation.us.title: Dirt & Trails - Project Leadfoot Is Complete
powernation.us.description: Our '94 Ford F-150 Leadfoot goes from pickup to beast with many modifications, a trail shakedown and a Bigfoot cameo.

powernation.us.title: Powernation Builds - Pro Street or No Street Nova
powernation.us.description: We're taking a sleek and sassy '62 Chevy Nova muscle car and turning it into a major track beast.

powernation.us.title: Engine Power - In House Power Mouse: Stage I

powernation.us.title: Engine Power - In House Power Mouse: Stage II Part I
powernation.us.description: The small block Chevy gets block modifications and a competition rotating assembly to complete a short-block.

powernation.us.title: Engine Power - In-House Power Mouse Roars

tastemadehome.us.title: Alan Cumming's Paradise Homes
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 An Epic Landscape Alan treks up the scenic hills of Liguria to an elegant subterranean villa and explores a sleek Irish barn house combining modern and traditional styles.

tastemadehome.us.title: Alan Cumming's Paradise Homes
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 A Serene Paradise Alan surfs the waters of the Norfolk Broads where a family have created their serene paradise home, and dives into a converted magical playground in the Canadian wilderness.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E07 Plunge Pool Paradise Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 Think Outside the Kitchen Stephanie is a new mom who finds joy in cooking because of the memories she made in India growing up. Now, she is determined to pass those memories on. Ellen knows Stephanie is a super fan and is determined not to let her down.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Organization Over Everything Andrew and Leah are the coolest, quirky couple in Eagle Rock. While they love their Spanish-style home, the kitchen is out of place in the worst way. With a small budget and big dreams, Ellen will have to get really creative to please this couple.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 A Baker's Dozen Problems Kandis is a home baker with a booming gluten-free business, but her tiny, chaotic kitchen is crumbling under pressure. With help from Ellen & a tight budget, she hopes to transform it into a pro space that supports her dream & her family's needs.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Vlad & Olga's Culinary Clash Vlad & Olga's cramped condo kitchen is straining their marriage. He wants function, she wants minimalism-& DIY fixes only cause fights. With no pantry, messy drawers & a 4-year-old, they call in Ellen to save their space-& their sanity.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Designing Joy Noelle, a designer at Hedley & Bennett & her husband Tim love to cook-but their small kitchen has killed the joy. With awkward cabinets, lost appliances & no counter space they need Ellen to bring order & fun back to their family's favorite room.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 A Chef's Dream Kitchen Culinary event producer Caryl Chinn's 1970s kitchen is a design disaster, embarrassing her during tastings with top chefs; with broken appliances, wasted space & clutter everywhere, she's counting on Ellen to deliver a kitchen fit for work & play.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Elevated Farmhouse Laura and James have four kids and one on the way! They have a tiny kitchen with the cooking output of a busy restaurant! Ellen adores this family and is determined to give them more than they could have ever hoped.

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Perfect Patio Pizza, Please Stephanie & John are back-but this time, the makeover's headed outside. With baby #2 on the way & a toddler who's asleep by 7, indoor cooking is off-limits. They need Ellen to transform their sad patio into a pizza paradise!

tastemadehome.us.title: Kitchen Glow Up
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 From Burnout to Cook-Off Barrie & Morgan are new homeowners & expecting parents. Barrie runs a catering business from home, but with bad storage, a leaky stove hood & no flow, her creativity's stalling & she's eyeing a rental kitchen to cope. Can Ellen save it?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 An English Manor in the Golden State Kathy and her husband John are relocating from New York City to sunny California. They're looking for a house that's closer to their family. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 The Educators' Dream Castle Michael and Lynne are looking for a new home for when they get married. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Pacific Palisades, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 The Ultimate Home for Art Lovers George and Bill are looking to cut their commute and move to the city. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Palo Alto, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E11 Multipurpose Cabana Brian and Sarah build a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Pub Paradise Bachelor Kyle's father Jack has helped him renovate his new home, but the backyard is still unusable. To help Kyle throw the ultimate housewarming party, Brian and Sarah build a sexy sports pub, a lounge area and a fire pit.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

truehistory.us.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - The Problem of Warfare's Origins
truehistory.us.description: Three types of evidence shed light on the origins of warfare; human remains bearing evidence of trauma; artifacts that function primarily as weapons; fortifications or depictions of warriors painted on cave walls; their interpretations are tricky.

truehistory.us.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - Sumer, Akkad, and Early Mesopotamian Warfare
truehistory.us.description: Written records first become available in the historical era; evidence reconstructs the conventions and conditions of warfare among the first cities in Sumer circa the 30th century B.C.; exploring the nature of Sumerian armies and battle tactics.

truehistory.us.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - Egyptian Warfare From the Old to New Kingdoms
truehistory.us.description: Evidence of warfare in Ancient Egypt is ambiguous, but it is much more plentiful in later periods; the pharaoh's role is increasingly that of a war leader; Egyptian warfare is transformed by the introduction of the chariot.

truehistory.us.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - The Battles of Megiddo and Kadesh
truehistory.us.description: In the New Kingdom of Egypt, one gets the first fully recorded battle in history, the Battle of Megiddo; covering the later Battle of Kadesh, which is attested in both Egyptian and Hittite accounts.

truehistory.us.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Palaces Past and Present
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the palaces of Saddam Hussein; discovering how he calls upon the ancient Egyptians and Babylonians for inspiration; how the architecture changes over time in response to threats from Iran and the United States.

truehistory.us.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Malkata Palace: Pharaoh, Foreigners, and Gods
truehistory.us.description: Traveling back to the 14th century B.C. in Egypt; how the Malkata Palace represents a microcosm of Egypt; architectural details reveal insights about religious rituals and how pharaohs attempt to assert their domination over others.

truehistory.us.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Amarna: Palace of the First Sun King
truehistory.us.description: Akhenaten shifts Egypt's capital to Amarna; how his worship of the sun disk defines an era built on temple crops, sacrifices and obedience to the pharaoh; how relocating his seat of power helps Akhenaten wrestle authority away from religious leaders.

truehistory.us.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Phaistos: Palaces Between Asia and Europe
truehistory.us.description: Studying Bronze Age Crete; the myth of Daedalus and his labyrinth symbolizes Crete's location at the intersection of multiple cultures; discovering the Phaistos Palace, the site of extravagant religious rituals and entertainment spectacles.

truehistory.us.title: The Architecture of Power: Great Palaces of the Ancient World - Palace of Nestor at Pylos and Bronze Age Greece
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the Palace of Nestor, a complex centered around the throne room; the ancient styles the Mycenaeans develop to bring these elaborate structures to life; what the arrangement of rooms reveals about how royals live and maintain control.

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - Rome-A Spectacular Civilization
truehistory.us.description: Examining the visual nature of Roman society and the key role of spectacular display; ranging from its center in the Roman Forum to its frontiers.

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - A Brief Survey of the Roman Empire
truehistory.us.description: This lecture provides a chronological, thematic and geographical framework; understanding the visual components of the Roman Empire; especially how different forms of governments and their citizens affect their art, architecture and public display.

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - Power, Conquest, and Romanization
truehistory.us.description: Learning the fundamental role of Rome's military in expanding the empire through conquest; creating and projecting the image of Roman power; introducing non-Romans to Roman values and identity.

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - Triumphal Processions-Victory Parades
truehistory.us.description: Conquest provides a reason for triumphal processions, sacrifices, games and other grand spectacles; it also allows for public and religious participation in a reinforcement of Roman values and identity.

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - Imperial Palaces
truehistory.us.description: Touring the palaces of Rome's powerful rulers; seeing how power and culture are displayed in forms that are admired and imitated by lower social classes.

truehistory.us.title: Experiencing Rome: A Visual Exploration of Antiquity's Greatest Empire - The Roman House-Space and Decoration
truehistory.us.description: As a stage for political, religious and social display, the houses of Roman elites celebrate Roman virtues and cultural identity; reinforcing to social equals and inferiors the influence of the inhabitants.

truehistory.us.title: Great Battles of the Ancient World - Why Study Battles? What Is War?
truehistory.us.description: Garrett G. Fagan addresses the importance of studying battles and surveys the changing scholarly approach to the subject; he concludes by looking at different definitions of warfare, particularly the operational and social-constructivist models.

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Made in Ghana
truehistory.us.description: Ghana is blessed with a vibrant culture and a scenic coastline.

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Ghanaian Botanical Gardens, Afropop, and Yoga
truehistory.us.description: To fully experience Ghana, explorers must spend time with local musicians and take a nature hike.

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Ghana's Sports, TV, and Philanthropy Champions
truehistory.us.description: Explorers must visit Kokrobite and Accra to connect with the true spirit of Ghana.

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Reclaiming Ghana: History and Homecoming
truehistory.us.description: The Ghanaian adventure is incomplete without a trip to W. E. B. Du Bois Centre and Elmina town.

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Senegal's African Renaissance
truehistory.us.description: Located at the westernmost point of the continent, Senegal is home to a prominent symbol of the African Renaissance.

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Senegal Style: Surfing, Textiles, and Art
truehistory.us.description: Senegal's essence lies in its weavers, artists, and the chance to surf along Dakar's Yoff Beach.

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Senegalese Wrestling, Farming, Griot and Dunes
truehistory.us.description: Explorers can conclude their tour with a glimpse into Senegal's wrestling culture and a local artist's unique story.

truehistory.us.title: Discovering West Africa: Ghana, Senegal, Cameroon - Cameroon's Mountain of Greatness
truehistory.us.description: Explorers can begin their Cameroon tour with a hike across the country's most impressive mountain.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: England, Scotland and Wales - Welcome to Britain
truehistory.us.description: Why Great Britain offers so much as a travel destination; thousand-year-old castles and cathedrals; contemporary art museums and scenic hikes; a look at the scope of all Britain has to offer, along with a few unique ideas.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: England, Scotland and Wales - Prehistoric Britain
truehistory.us.description: The beginning of Great Britain's history 5,000 years ago; a mysterious ancient people whose only vestiges are earthworks and stone circles; the massive popularity of Stonehenge; visiting other ancient ruins such as Avebury or Maiden Castle.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: England, Scotland and Wales - Roman Britain
truehistory.us.description: The Roman conquest; how the Romans invaded Great Britain and spread their territory; Hadrian's Wall marking the edge of the empire; the Roman impact on Great Britain, from the city of Bath to the island's long and straight roads.

truehistory.us.title: The Great Tours: England, Scotland and Wales - Anglo-Saxon and Viking Britain
truehistory.us.description: How a number of Germanic tribes stepped in to fill the power vacuum left after the Romans left Britain; exploring the Anglo-Saxon conquests; the Viking attacks in the Middle Ages; Offa's Dyke and the monastery of Lindisfarne.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Salmon Tacos, Meatballs, & Perogies in Las Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie dazzles in Las Vegas where he enjoys crunchy salmon skin tacos, an homage to after-school snacks, and the dish that put Martha Stewart on the map.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Pierogies, Bagels, and Ramen in NYC
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza takes a LOT of bites out of the big apple as he samples warm pillowy bagels & schmear, grabs pierogies at an old school Ukrainian spot, gets the scoop on innovative ice cream flavors, and slurps up some real ramen.

tastemadetravel.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels - Hidden Escapes
tastemadetravel.us.description: The team discovers hidden retreats in Canada, Iceland, Sweden and the U.K., from sunken hotels to retreats surrounded by lava fields and a compound with military history.

tastemadetravel.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels - Extreme Escapes
tastemadetravel.us.description: There are unusual hotels ranging from jungle retreats to converted caves.

tastemadetravel.us.title: World's Most Secret Hotels - Hidden Retreats
tastemadetravel.us.description: Uncovering truly remarkable and hidden retreats in Canada, Iceland, Sweden and the UK; from underwater sunken hotels to retreats surrounded by lava fields.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Getting to the Roots
tastemadetravel.us.description: The chefs and owners of Xokol restaurant in Guadalajara reconnect with their roots; chef Marin creates a drink and dessert inspired by his grandmother; chef Francisco Migoya makes a dessert.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Best Tacos In Mérida
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Food Meets Art
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
tastemadetravel.us.description: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Art of the Egg
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Famous Pastes of Spices
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Carne Asada with La Familia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Flour Power
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sonoran Family Favorites
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Legends of the Sonoran Sea
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Super Sonoran
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco. (Cooking) - 2024-02-15

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cooking for the Crew
tastemadetravel.us.description: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico, they stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo where Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast in the rustic outdoor kitchen - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce. (Cooking) - 2024-02-22

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S13 E26 Thermostat; Solar Roger teaches Kevin about lengths to consider when mowing the lawn; Richard installs a thermostat that interfaces with a smartphone to save energy and money; Ross walks Kevin through the installation of a photovoltaic solar array on a barn.

waypointtv.us.description: S02 E05 Every year, hunters from across the country flock to various parts of Texas to extend their hunting season; friends from Struttinbuck do just the same, as Matt and Clede make the long drive to Del Rio to hunt South Texas bucks on the Mexico border.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Double T Outfitters
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E08 We join Bobby Falkenberg as he joins Bret Ferguson from Double T Outfitters. Bobby is an avid outdoorsman, judge, and father. Bret manages 30,000 acres in Ozona TX, the knowledge he has of every inch of this amazing low fence ranch is remarkable.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : The Hill
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E02 From its inception, the F E Hill Ranch creates opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories, including a tradition of fathers and sons hunting together.

waypointtv.us.description: After a slow opening day with hot, humid temperatures, the focus shifts back to "Big Heavy" on day two of bow season; Chipper Jones joins Tyler in camp at Realtree Farms on September 10th to try his luck on a Georgia giant as well.

waypointtv.us.title: Realtree Roadtrips : Epic Bowhunting in Georgia - EHD Caused Broken Foot?
waypointtv.us.description: S03 E25 Bryan Brown and Michael Pitts go on a week-long bowhunting trip in Georgia during the rut; Pitts tries to find out if an EHD caused a foot injury on the giant 10 point that he is hunting.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
waypointtv.us.description: S04 E12 A Wilder Harvest How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting communities who rely on the yearly cycle.

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : The Bear
waypointtv.us.description: Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound -- Alaska Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of salmon fishing and hunting black-tailed deer.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound - Alabama Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting; he makes dishes with his former "Master Chef" contestant, Alex.

waypointtv.us.title: Local Knowledge : SeaSafe Snook: Part 1
waypointtv.us.description: In Grant, Fla., four million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon; they are paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash cleanups to help restore one of Florida's most critical ecosystems.

waypointtv.us.title: Chasin' the Sun : Red to Black to Jack
waypointtv.us.description: Capt. Justin Leake and a fellow guide search for redfish along the beach, but Mother Nature has other ideas, giving them a show they didn't expect.

waypointtv.us.description: S18 E01 Capts. Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor run west from Hawks Cay to fish the spring tarpon migration at the legendary Bahia Honda Bridge.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Bonefishing Key West with Captain Brandon Cyr
waypointtv.us.description: S18 E02 Capts. Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor head down to Key West to join Capt. Brandon Cyr for some skinny water bonefishing.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Baby Tarpon with Captain Brandon Cyr
waypointtv.us.description: S18 E03 Capts. Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor fish the Florida Keys with Capt. Brandon Cyr for baby tarpon in the mangroves.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Grouper and Tarpon with Jamey Caldwell
waypointtv.us.description: S18 E04 Capts. Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor take Sergeant Major Jamey Caldwell fishing out of Hawks Cay for some grouper and tarpon action.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Night Vision Tarpon with Jamey Caldwell
waypointtv.us.description: S18 E05 Sergeant Major Jamey Caldwell brings some game-changing technology along as he joins Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor for some nighttime tarpon fishing at the Long Key Bridge.

waypointtv.us.title: Saltwater Experience : Dolphin and Swordfish with Sam Milazzo
waypointtv.us.description: S18 E06 Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Florida Keys guide Sam Milazzo to find the elusive daytime swordfish but run into some great dolphin fishing on the way.

waypointtv.us.title: Hooked on The Palm Beaches : Family Fishing Fun
waypointtv.us.description: Featuring Black Dog Charter Fishing in Jupiter, Reed the Fishmonger, Loggerhead Marinelife pier fishing initiative & a hook and cook recipe.

waypointtv.us.description: The Cast aims to reveal various angling experiences tied to a deeper meaning through the lens of personal experiences; from fresh water in the Midwest, to exploring the saltwater of the coasts.

wipeoutxtra.us.description: S06 E09 A dramatic finale, as the finest contestants from across the series, champions and losing finalists, once again hop on the flight to South America to take on the snow-clad, foam-padded obstacle course.

wipeoutxtra.us.title: Total Wipeout
wipeoutxtra.us.description: S05 E05 Last Chance Saloon Twenty foolhardy Brits return to the scenes of their wipeouts in previous series in "The Last Chance Saloon."

wipeoutxtra.us.title: Total Wipeout
wipeoutxtra.us.description: S05 E04 Contestants including a maths teacher, Rastafarian postman and ageing rocker battle it out, looking to make it to the end.
